### `tests/test_relay_plan_linearity_integration.py` (python) — Integration tests that feed group dicts through the full transitive_reduce → classify_chains → _relay_plan_is_linear pipeline to verify linearity detection is robust across redundant-edge chains, genuine forks, and varied DAG topologies (long chains, wide/trailing forks, disconnected components, out-of-order declarations) plus structural pipeline invariants. <!--#4d63a4e90aa8f0fc|1e27f06711d57ac8-->
- `_is_linear` (function) — Test helper that runs the complete TR → classify → linearity-check pipeline on a list of group dicts and returns the boolean verdict. <!--#812062e40d5b42d1-->
- `_g` (function) — Compact factory helper that builds a group dict with the given id, order, and dependency list. <!--#0383f1b0979aaf98-->
- `TestRedundantEdgesStillLinear` (class) — Test class asserting that chains carrying redundant transitive edges remain detected as linear while genuine forks are not flattened. <!--#370646d1081282fe-->
  - `TestRedundantEdgesStillLinear.test_redundant_edge_stays_linear` (method) — Verifies the A→B,A→C,B→C redundancy is treated as a convergence rather than a fork, staying linear before and after transitive reduction. <!--#ed6ce66a9c71b33f-->
  - `TestRedundantEdgesStillLinear.test_cascading_redundant_edges_stay_linear` (method) — Verifies a fully transitively-closed chain (A→B→C→D plus all redundant edges) is still recognized as linear. <!--#60d238f7ddcb1553-->
  - `TestRedundantEdgesStillLinear.test_genuine_fork_stays_fork_after_reduction` (method) — Verifies a true fork (A→B, A→C with no B↔C edge) is non-linear and unchanged by transitive reduction. <!--#859340a1a548c020-->
  - `TestRedundantEdgesStillLinear.test_diamond_with_redundant_root_edge` (method) — Verifies a diamond with a redundant root edge stays non-linear because the B/C fork from A is real. <!--#fa26c99d98969f10-->
- `TestExtendedTopologies` (class) — Test class covering topology shapes beyond the unit tests: long chains, wide forks, disconnected components, out-of-order declarations, and trailing/converging forks. <!--#14c0544fd7b8b986-->
  - `TestExtendedTopologies.test_long_linear_chain` (method) — Verifies a 10-node linear chain is detected as linear. <!--#ab7d88be999d89a4-->
  - `TestExtendedTopologies.test_wide_fork_from_single_root` (method) — Verifies a single root with four independent dependents is non-linear. <!--#6d0e6fead8834c19-->
  - `TestExtendedTopologies.test_two_disconnected_linear_chains` (method) — Verifies two independent chains (two roots) are reported as non-linear. <!--#ef94561a36e81d7f-->
  - `TestExtendedTopologies.test_chain_with_out_of_order_declaration` (method) — Verifies that declaring chain nodes in reverse order doesn't affect linearity detection. <!--#d6d702d2db271fda-->
  - `TestExtendedTopologies.test_trailing_fork_off_linear_prefix` (method) — Verifies a fork branching off the tail of an otherwise linear prefix breaks linearity. <!--#0625b96838d54087-->
  - `TestExtendedTopologies.test_converging_two_chains_at_tail` (method) — Verifies two independent chains converging at one tail are non-linear due to having multiple roots. <!--#a195c25304e6123b-->
- `TestPipelineInvariants` (class) — Test class checking structural invariants of the pipeline: return type, input immutability, and single/empty-node edge cases. <!--#3bf88fa7116e5ac6-->
  - `TestPipelineInvariants.test_pipeline_returns_relayplan_instance` (method) — Verifies classify_chains returns a RelayPlan instance even after transitive reduction. <!--#7ac9d81d62dc3d7c-->
  - `TestPipelineInvariants.test_pipeline_does_not_mutate_input` (method) — Verifies transitive_reduce deep-copies so the caller's original group dicts are left unmutated. <!--#b5bf3eafe801dd0c-->
  - `TestPipelineInvariants.test_single_node_pipeline_is_linear` (method) — Verifies a single-node plan passes the pipeline and is reported linear. <!--#621ffc568d8b0171-->
  - `TestPipelineInvariants.test_empty_pipeline_is_not_linear` (method) — Verifies an empty group list yields an empty RelayPlan that is reported non-linear (zero roots). <!--#c0e9a7e90c37ae82-->

### `tests/test_resumable_live_process_gate.py` (python) — Test suite verifying the DaemonAggregator's live-process gate, which marks RUNNING flows with a still-alive process as non-resumable while keeping dead-process, paused, failed, completed, and provider-less legacy cases correct across both active engine.json and per-flow resumable-snapshot paths. <!--#aae203929a2ce6cd|86a3f1d26162b3df-->

### `tests/test_run_drain_interjections.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying the run-flow interjection draining/consumption logic: that interjections are buffered into a prefix only for discovery-style PAUSED steps (not RUNNING or CONFIRM-paused steps), are recorded in user_interjections and written to per-step history jsonl, and that the prefix consumer joins/clears buffered entries while gracefully handling empty buffers, missing state, and whitespace-only entries. <!--#cb0898bedef64c80|47c96637fb73fcc3-->

- `test_webui_answer_retry_resets_step_and_increments_counter` (function) — Asserts a pre-seeded webui 'retry' answer resets the step to PENDING, bumps retry_count, re-runs (succeeding), and cleans up the consumed answer. <!--#d0076d7da124d786-->

### `tests/test_run_lock_lifecycle.py` (python) — Pytest suite verifying the deferred main-worktree lock lifecycle in `se3 run`'s `_ensure_main_lock_for_step`, covering the (1a)/(1b) fix: discovery steps never hold the lock, free locks acquire silently, contended locks persist and stream `waiting_for_lock=True` before blocking then clear it on acquire, stale locks are reclaimed, `--worktree` bodies no-op, the flag round-trips through engine.json, and Ctrl+C while waiting clears the flag before persisting and exits 130. <!--#8c67add0ff8c7498|f6ba42b86a2f993f-->
- `project` (function) — Pytest fixture creating a temp project tree with `se3/state/` and returning its root path. <!--#022223c2707b4436-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a RUNNING FlowInstance containing a single RUNNING step of the given StepType. <!--#7e690c403fae6b4f-->
- `_read_engine` (function) — Helper that reads and parses the persisted `se3/state/engine.json` into a dict. <!--#a46e0c5f883e7add-->
- `_jsonl_path` (function) — Helper returning the streaming history JSONL path for a given flow and step. <!--#ac9f7e26db328f1e-->
- `test_waiting_for_lock_roundtrips_true` (function) — Asserts a True `waiting_for_lock` flag serializes and round-trips through FlowInstance dict conversion. <!--#9aa058df1ebf86a0-->
- `test_waiting_for_lock_false_omitted_and_reads_false` (function) — Asserts a default-False `waiting_for_lock` is omitted from serialization and legacy files lacking the key read back as False. <!--#f7596474f23d651f-->
- `test_discovery_step_does_not_acquire_lock` (function) — Verifies a discovery step never acquires the main-worktree lock (1a), leaving it genuinely free for another acquirer. <!--#1917614de3187410-->
- `test_free_lock_acquired_without_waiting_state` (function) — Verifies a free lock is acquired immediately with no `waiting_for_lock` flag set and no streaming event written. <!--#c13a70cfc785211d-->
- `test_already_held_lock_is_noop` (function) — Verifies that calling the helper when the lock is already held is a no-op with no waiting state. <!--#fb10b44cff47523b-->
- `test_worktree_body_none_lock_is_noop` (function) — Verifies that a `--worktree` flow body (main_lock is None) is a pure no-op leaving `waiting_for_lock` False. <!--#7e09f0d84a0e9043-->
- `test_busy_lock_surfaces_waiting_state_then_acquires` (function) — Verifies a contended lock persists `waiting_for_lock=True` and writes a streaming event before blocking, then acquires and clears the flag once the holder releases (1b). <!--#cfdeccfc12afffea-->
- `test_stale_lock_reclaimed_without_waiting` (function) — Verifies a stale lock file (dead PID) is silently reclaimed without surfacing any waiting state or event. <!--#4e6c6df81a403dc6-->
- `test_interrupt_while_waiting_clears_flag_before_persist` (function) — Verifies that a Ctrl+C while blocked waiting on the lock clears `waiting_for_lock` before the final persist and returns exit code 130, so a dead process is never left marked as waiting. <!--#bbef17afe411b2c3-->

- `test_cli_sink_noop_for_interactive_and_plan` (function) — Test asserting CliSink renders nothing for interactive/special step types (discovery/plan) whose CLI output is owned elsewhere. <!--#8ed340c122752059-->

- `test_cli_sink_derives_skip_type_from_step_when_event_type_missing` (function) — Test asserting CliSink's skip decision falls back to the step object's step_type when the event carries no step_type string. <!--#dc7c553d936fd8d5-->
- `test_record_step_event_shape_is_stable_and_serializable` (function) — Test asserting record_step_event writes a stably-keyed, JSON-round-trippable record the frontend's normalizeRecord depends on. <!--#33db12a654c63568-->
- `test_get_step_history_skips_step_event_records` (function) — Test asserting get_step_history surfaces only chat turns and skips the step-event report-card records on the CLI side. <!--#2c139bc62c66f17c-->
- `_seed_active_flow` (function) — Test helper that writes a running engine.json plus a per-step jsonl of raw records and returns the jsonl path for later appends. <!--#9b072684d23c3051-->
- `_step_completed_line` (function) — Test helper returning the exact step_completed line shape record_step_event writes for a finished step. <!--#04c5489a401cda47-->
- `_frontend_outputs` (function) — Test helper mirroring the frontend's normalizeRecord to extract step outputs from a pushed daemon record. <!--#c2387805ae6ac17a-->
- `_step_events` (function) — Test helper filtering a daemon read's records down to step_completed/step_failed events. <!--#bad92caf751ada5d-->
- `test_read_active_flows_returns_step_completed_record` (function) — Test asserting the daemon incremental reader returns an active flow's step_completed line interleaved with chat turns, in frontend-consumable shape with a correct cursor. <!--#32072320e3715161-->
- `test_active_flow_incremental_does_not_duplicate_step_completed` (function) — Test asserting repeated cursor-based polling never re-pushes a line and surfaces a new step's card exactly once. <!--#1217b3033bc6e89e-->
- `test_step_completed_appended_to_existing_step_file_is_picked_up` (function) — Test asserting a step_completed line appended to an existing step jsonl is surfaced by the next incremental poll and not re-pushed. <!--#74b7903252c7b33f-->
- `_make_discovery_step` (function) — Test helper building a lightweight SimpleNamespace stand-in for a discovery step with outputs/inputs. <!--#b8d8ddba8c6b20b9-->
- `_make_discovery_flow` (function) — Test helper building a lightweight SimpleNamespace stand-in for a flow with just a flow_id. <!--#bfc445ee98f986b1-->
- `_NullPersistence` (class) — Minimal no-op persistence stub used by the discovery-pause tests. <!--#a91cbba4c423b299-->
  - `_NullPersistence.save_flow` (method) — No-op save_flow stub method on the null persistence test double. <!--#babe5bd5029057a4-->
- `test_discovery_confirm_call_payload_kind_options_context` (function) — Test asserting _write_discovery_call emits a confirm call carrying the right kind, options, context.flow_id, and the textual confirm hint plus refined description. <!--#5c9d9991b7b9ef6f-->
- `test_discovery_confirm_call_surfaces_via_aggregator_scoped_with_options` (function) — Test asserting the daemon aggregator parses a discovery confirm call into a flow-scoped PendingCall preserving its kind and confirm option. <!--#2f5503a8e1aec344-->
- `test_discovery_confirm_submission_gates_on_one` (function) — Test asserting submitting "1" confirms and advances the discovery gate while any other reply keeps refining and clears the confirm flag. <!--#0ee7e4a05b7622a2-->

- `test_summarize_records_user_and_assistant_to_jsonl` (function) — Test asserting summarize_handler persists both the user prompt and the assistant markdown summary to the per-step jsonl via the real LLMCaller path. <!--#d41222d9714e1414-->
- `test_summarize_records_incrementally_readable_in_frontend_shape` (function) — Test asserting the summarize chat turns and step_completed card (carrying outputs.summary) are surfaced by the daemon reader in the shape the Work Summary report renderer consumes. <!--#f9bc8bc22ebd0025-->

- `_write_flow_call` (function) — Test helper writing a flow-scoped, kind-tagged call file with context.flow_id/step_id under se3/calls. <!--#5047200ddd7bf0f9-->

- `test_unresolvable_step_call_is_kept` (function) — Test asserting a call whose step_id is absent from the flow's steps map is never dropped by the progress heuristic. <!--#8ff977688f1c6020-->

### `tests/test_salvage_cmd.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the salvage command, exercising session loading, git-diff assessment, change commits, salvage-issue creation, session archiving, and the end-to-end salvage() pipeline across valid, missing, corrupted, and fault-isolated scenarios. <!--#7180fa3737e83eb3|e3b71daec0eed5f2-->
- `project_root` (function) — Pytest fixture creating a minimal temp project tree with .git, se3/state, and se3/issues/open|closed directories. <!--#b92bd43dc873f422-->
- `valid_flow` (function) — Pytest fixture building a RUNNING FlowInstance with a completed IMPLEMENT step and a running TEST step as the current step. <!--#c8cd7a0cde7baa83-->
- `_write_flow_state` (function) — Helper that serializes a FlowInstance and writes it to se3/state/engine.json. <!--#4bcee323469ae997-->
- `TestLoadSession` (class) — Test class for _load_session covering valid, corrupted, and absent session state. <!--#f0e20cd8a1029298-->
  - `TestLoadSession.test_load_valid_session` (method) — Asserts a well-formed engine.json loads into the expected flow with no warnings. <!--#108b56ebc053b207-->
  - `TestLoadSession.test_load_corrupted_session` (method) — Asserts loading truncated/invalid JSON yields warnings rather than crashing. <!--#48d8e4fc02a95f2d-->
  - `TestLoadSession.test_load_no_session` (method) — Asserts loading with no state file returns None plus a warning. <!--#fd1121ced9b68b2d-->
- `TestAssessGitDiff` (class) — Test class for _assess_git_diff using a mocked subprocess.run. <!--#78b474320fc89aaf-->
  - `TestAssessGitDiff.test_assess_with_changes` (method) — Asserts git status output of two modified files is counted and listed correctly. <!--#cd4da7006cbeede3-->
  - `TestAssessGitDiff.test_assess_no_changes` (method) — Asserts empty git output yields a zero changed-file count. <!--#aba684164a40391d-->
- `TestCommitChanges` (class) — Test class for _commit_changes covering the no-changes skip and successful commits. <!--#c891217ffa2a4e6d-->
  - `TestCommitChanges.test_skip_when_no_changes` (method) — Asserts _commit_changes returns None when there are no changed files. <!--#29cf9b0d72c2bfa4-->
  - `TestCommitChanges.test_commit_with_changes` (method) — Asserts a successful add/commit/rev-parse sequence returns the short commit hash. <!--#2b170a211240ccf9-->
  - `TestCommitChanges.test_commit_message_contains_task` (method) — Asserts the generated commit message includes the [salvage] tag and the task description. <!--#3ca001eb162a4a28-->
- `TestCreateSalvageIssues` (class) — Test class for _create_salvage_issues across flow/no-flow and changes/no-changes combinations. <!--#ee7537a090d27a6a-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_creates_issue_with_flow` (method) — Asserts a flow plus changes produces one medium-priority 'Incomplete' issue tagged auto-discovered and source:salvage. <!--#27e32ef779b51fd2-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_creates_issue_without_flow` (method) — Asserts changes with no flow still produce one source:salvage-tagged issue. <!--#2d8c7d8fe8235505-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_no_issue_when_no_flow_and_no_changes` (method) — Asserts no issue is created when there is neither a flow nor any changes. <!--#1f638d980642972b-->
  - `TestCreateSalvageIssues.test_issue_includes_step_history` (method) — Asserts the created issue's description includes the flow's step history (e.g. 'implement'). <!--#b6edefcd45285d85-->
- `TestArchiveSession` (class) — Test class for _archive_session covering archiving, the no-session skip, and resumable-snapshot cleanup. <!--#f6ec98048f053502-->
  - `TestArchiveSession.test_archives_existing_session` (method) — Asserts archiving removes engine.json and writes a single timestamped file into state/archive. <!--#191bd39fc521dd01-->
  - `TestArchiveSession.test_skip_when_no_session` (method) — Asserts _archive_session returns False when no session state exists. <!--#fa4c2bac434c9abd-->
  - `TestArchiveSession.test_clears_resumable_snapshot` (method) — Asserts archiving also deletes the per-flow resumable snapshot so the daemon can't re-advertise a dispositioned flow as resumable. <!--#123d09285bbc8183-->
- `TestSalvageFullPipeline` (class) — Test class for the end-to-end salvage() entry point across valid, missing, corrupted, and fault-isolated runs. <!--#57a9301688b7c403-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_salvage_with_valid_session` (method) — Asserts salvage() exits 0 for a valid session with no git changes. <!--#9d233cd544ee0617-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_salvage_with_no_session` (method) — Asserts salvage() exits 0 when there is no session and no changes. <!--#3cffe2b924ae2b7f-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_each_step_independent` (method) — Asserts a failing _load_session is isolated so other steps still run and salvage() exits 1. <!--#49fabb56d890de94-->
  - `TestSalvageFullPipeline.test_salvage_with_corrupted_session` (method) — Asserts a corrupted session still permits git-diff-based salvage and commit, exiting 0. <!--#99d514bcff481138-->

### `tests/test_se3_local_yaml.py` (python) — Test suite verifying SE3's se3.local.yaml config override behavior — that it takes precedence over and wholesale-replaces (never deep-merges) se3.yaml across all per-section loaders, that project-root detection and parent-walk helpers recognize a local-only marker, and that deprecation-warning source labels name the file actually read. <!--#281261cc40d5eebf|cc89b0f407a64df9-->
- `isolated_global_home` (function) — Pytest fixture that monkeypatches Path.home() to a clean temp dir so tests don't read the real ~/.se3/config.yaml. <!--#2710907cd4f6608c-->
- `make_worktree` (function) — Pytest fixture that builds a real git repo plus a linked worktree, yields (main_root, worktree_root), and cleans up the worktree afterward (skips if git is unavailable). <!--#c4d9c6aee19fd0a4-->
- `TestGetProjectConfigPath` (class) — Tests get_project_config_path resolution across the four combinations of se3.yaml / se3.local.yaml existence. <!--#6fd6e6989d997478-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_neither_exists_returns_se3_yaml` (method) — Asserts the canonical se3.yaml path is returned when neither config file exists. <!--#1c017c2c817cbf01-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_only_se3_yaml_exists` (method) — Asserts se3.yaml is selected when only se3.yaml exists. <!--#c78f7fafb9fbbbc2-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_only_local_exists` (method) — Asserts se3.local.yaml is selected when only the local file exists. <!--#c7314b71bade616c-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPath.test_both_exist_local_wins` (method) — Asserts se3.local.yaml wins over se3.yaml when both exist. <!--#1a4745105f526658-->
- `TestLoadersReadLocal` (class) — Tests that each per-section config loader reads its values from se3.local.yaml when present. <!--#0b35fd95c83e5ca0-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_version_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies VersionConfig.load reads enabled/confidence_threshold from se3.local.yaml. <!--#4cbf5fd61fb9bb51-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_language_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies LanguageConfig.load reads language/spec_language from se3.local.yaml. <!--#a36b74cbeea4d89d-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_test_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies TestConfig.load reads command/timeout/timeout_multiplier from se3.local.yaml. <!--#ea87a16f74393c32-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_conflict_resolver_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies ConflictResolverConfig.load reads strategy from se3.local.yaml. <!--#17380ffccff5558e-->
  - `TestLoadersReadLocal.test_implement_config_loads_from_local` (method) — Verifies ImplementConfig.load reads group_loc_threshold from se3.local.yaml. <!--#bc82ae7bc6063954-->
- `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml` (class) — Tests that se3.local.yaml wholesale replaces se3.yaml (no deep merge), so absent local values do not leak from se3.yaml. <!--#013f0ed53a20a1a2-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_version_config_not_merged` (method) — Verifies version config from local fully replaces se3.yaml's version values rather than deep-merging. <!--#7f6d23d05b9a16d6-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_language_yaml_shadowed_completely` (method) — Verifies a language key absent from local stays None rather than leaking from se3.yaml. <!--#a647e398c2f24961-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_implement_yaml_shadowed_when_local_missing_section` (method) — Verifies a section omitted from local falls back to built-in defaults, not se3.yaml's value. <!--#92a15c4b5ca47320-->
  - `TestLocalReplacesSe3Yaml.test_conflict_resolver_not_merged` (method) — Verifies conflict_resolver.strategy from local replaces se3.yaml's value. <!--#a3f4cb20e77c77ee-->
- `TestOnlySe3YamlRegression` (class) — Regression tests that loaders still read se3.yaml correctly when no se3.local.yaml is present. <!--#71053e8fa7794ce4-->
  - `TestOnlySe3YamlRegression.test_version_config_from_se3_yaml` (method) — Verifies VersionConfig.load reads from se3.yaml when local is absent. <!--#5d5413ef5fd8f867-->
  - `TestOnlySe3YamlRegression.test_test_config_from_se3_yaml` (method) — Verifies TestConfig.load reads timeout from se3.yaml when local is absent. <!--#92c43a159a306559-->
- `TestConfirmationSourceLabel` (class) — Tests that load_confirmation_config's deprecation-warning source label names the file actually read (local vs yaml). <!--#54ff6a1501b833db-->
  - `TestConfirmationSourceLabel.test_source_label_is_local_when_local_exists` (method) — Verifies the deprecation warning names se3.local.yaml (not se3.yaml) when local is the active source. <!--#061f5ea5a9cc83fe-->
  - `TestConfirmationSourceLabel.test_source_label_is_yaml_when_only_yaml_exists` (method) — Verifies the deprecation warning names se3.yaml when only se3.yaml exists. <!--#6b825f6151931a10-->
- `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly` (class) — Tests is_se3_project_root recognizes a directory marked only by se3.local.yaml (and rejects unmarked dirs). <!--#6d4e2472ee38d63c-->
  - `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly.test_detects_project_with_only_local` (method) — Asserts a dir containing only se3.local.yaml is detected as a project root. <!--#22ff59f674af10b7-->
  - `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly.test_detects_project_with_only_yaml` (method) — Asserts a dir containing only se3.yaml is detected as a project root. <!--#f5d6e60a84ff9ac3-->
  - `TestIsSe3ProjectRootLocalOnly.test_rejects_directory_without_markers` (method) — Asserts a dir with no SE3 markers is not detected as a project root. <!--#77639b59a1490907-->

  - `TestParentWalkFindsLocalOnlyRoot.test_salvage_find_project_root_walks_up_to_local_only_parent` (method) — Verifies salvage_cmd._find_project_root walks up to a local-only parent. <!--#163f72992b2bccb4-->
  - `TestParentWalkFindsLocalOnlyRoot.test_run_get_project_root_walks_up_to_local_only_parent` (method) — Verifies run.get_project_root walks up to a local-only parent. <!--#f1a85a78ba25e750-->
- `TestStepConfigLocal` (class) — Tests that StepConfig and apply_step_config read step append config from se3.local.yaml, replacing se3.yaml. <!--#052e1eee55ad4bf4-->
  - `TestStepConfigLocal.test_step_config_loads_append_from_local` (method) — Verifies StepConfig.load reads steps.append from se3.local.yaml. <!--#9389c2904b018f87-->
  - `TestStepConfigLocal.test_step_config_local_replaces_yaml` (method) — Verifies local steps.append fully replaces se3.yaml's append entries. <!--#649fb99433ac93d4-->
  - `TestStepConfigLocal.test_apply_step_config_uses_local` (method) — Verifies apply_step_config appends SUMMARIZE based on the local config. <!--#a422163840d1813e-->
- `TestMaxFixIterationsLocal` (class) — Tests get_max_fix_iterations reads workflow.max_fix_iterations from se3.local.yaml, with local replacing se3.yaml. <!--#4eefab9cc045eb55-->
  - `TestMaxFixIterationsLocal.test_get_max_fix_iterations_reads_local` (method) — Verifies get_max_fix_iterations reads the value from se3.local.yaml. <!--#e43ea7a517ccaa44-->
  - `TestMaxFixIterationsLocal.test_get_max_fix_iterations_local_replaces_yaml` (method) — Verifies local's max_fix_iterations wins and se3.yaml's value does not leak. <!--#8710eee2f541156b-->
- `TestContextBuilderLocal` (class) — Tests context_builder injection whitelists (issue_discovery, spec_names) honor overrides from se3.local.yaml. <!--#e61747632fb8f9cc-->
  - `TestContextBuilderLocal.test_issue_discovery_injection_reads_local` (method) — Verifies get_issue_discovery_injection respects a steps whitelist added in se3.local.yaml. <!--#5af3b441a889cca3-->
  - `TestContextBuilderLocal.test_spec_names_injection_reads_local` (method) — Verifies get_spec_names_injection respects a steps whitelist added in se3.local.yaml (avoiding default/forbidden steps). <!--#a1699fe38d3fb4ab-->
- `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings` (class) — Tests that a broken/non-mapping se3.local.yaml falls back to defaults and emits a one-shot shadow warning across both read paths. <!--#076df56da0dfe7ce-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings._reset_warned_set` (method) — Helper that clears the one-shot malformed-local warning dedup set before each test. <!--#2b3ac40f31cb8273-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_loader_logs_when_local_is_malformed_yaml` (method) — Verifies invalid YAML in local yields defaults plus a shadow warning. <!--#f83f9cd02f8859b2-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_loader_logs_when_local_is_non_mapping` (method) — Verifies a top-level-list (non-mapping) local yields defaults plus a shadow warning. <!--#9eeb85945f721637-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_load_agent_registry_logs_when_local_is_falsy_non_mapping` (method) — Verifies the _read_yaml path classifies a falsy-non-mapping local (e.g. []) as malformed and warns, preventing se3.yaml agents from leaking. <!--#48c55559ef5f8a7b-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_valid_empty_local_yaml_no_warning` (method) — Verifies a valid-but-empty local ({}) means 'no overrides' with no warning and still shadows se3.yaml. <!--#45be68e8a8213272-->
  - `TestMalformedLocalYamlWarnings.test_warning_dedup_only_once_per_path` (method) — Verifies the malformed-local shadow warning fires only once per path across repeated loads. <!--#a11f88c046225257-->
- `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile` (class) — Tests get_project_config_path's handling of non-regular-file local paths (directory, symlinks, unreadable file). <!--#338956c6cde96b3b-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_directory_at_local_path_falls_back_to_yaml` (method) — Verifies a directory at the local path is skipped and se3.yaml is used. <!--#1af59b25b50dc1f8-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_symlink_to_real_file_is_accepted_as_override` (method) — Verifies a symlink at the local path pointing to a real file is accepted as the active override. <!--#db0acc2a9aa62c15-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_dangling_symlink_at_local_path_falls_back_to_yaml` (method) — Verifies a dangling symlink at the local path is skipped in favor of se3.yaml. <!--#4d3b25697e5b9a05-->
  - `TestGetProjectConfigPathNonFile.test_unreadable_regular_file_still_selected_and_readers_fall_back` (method) — Verifies a chmod-0 local file is still selected but downstream readers fall back to defaults with both 'failed to read' and shadow warnings. <!--#92a1464c215a9e1a-->
- `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge` (class) — Tests that ~/.se3/config.yaml and se3.local.yaml combine via the same merge rules as se3.yaml (entry-level agent merge, defaults whole-replace). <!--#a5b0161eedc7d15c-->

  - `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge.test_local_overrides_global_for_same_agent_name` (method) — Verifies local wins for a same-named agent declared in both global and local. <!--#04009aad435da9ce-->
  - `TestGlobalPlusLocalAgentMerge.test_load_agents_uses_global_defaults_when_local_omits_them` (method) — Verifies global llm_caller.defaults still apply when local omits the defaults section. <!--#8460123c96733ce1-->

  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_resolve_main_repo_root_returns_none_for_non_git` (method) — Verifies _resolve_main_repo_root returns None for a plain directory. <!--#d1b52ecedc3435a0-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_resolve_main_repo_root_returns_none_for_regular_git_repo` (method) — Verifies _resolve_main_repo_root returns None for a normal (non-worktree) git repo. <!--#8bffa0c17c908a38-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_malformed_git_output_returns_none` (method) — Verifies _resolve_main_repo_root returns None when git rev-parse emits an unexpected number of stdout lines. <!--#4eb292b46cd5c93b-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_resolve_main_repo_root_finds_main_repo` (method) — Verifies _resolve_main_repo_root identifies a worktree and returns the main repo root. <!--#4328063c5b02299b-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_main_local_overrides_worktree_yaml` (method) — Verifies tier 2: main-repo se3.local.yaml overrides worktree se3.yaml, with a main-prefixed label. <!--#70096ca4ebc874ed-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_worktree_local_beats_main_local` (method) — Verifies tier 1: worktree se3.local.yaml wins over main-repo se3.local.yaml. <!--#86673ca60e85fa77-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_worktree_yaml_beats_main_yaml_when_no_local` (method) — Verifies tier 3: worktree se3.yaml wins over main-repo se3.yaml when no local exists. <!--#47d7102b52d07840-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_main_yaml_fallback_when_only_main_has_yaml` (method) — Verifies tier 4: main-repo se3.yaml is used when nothing else exists. <!--#4702f34418b5e53f-->
  - `TestWorktreeFourTierPriority.test_all_four_tiers_with_unique_markers` (method) — Verifies the full priority order using unique marker keys when all four files exist (worktree-local wins). <!--#5621542ce17e72ee-->

### `tests/test_server_auth_e2e.py` (python) — End-to-end TestClient tests for the server's auth surface — login/logout/me, session cookie issuance and Secure/HttpOnly attributes, rate-limit lockout, one-time break-glass admin sessions, fail-closed app assembly, admin-only user creation (no public registration), full daemon-key bootstrap/isolation chains, and the hard rule that credentials never leak to logs. <!--#3b7ac7d12fcd4e3f|7cc46e556fe4f5e3-->
- `client_and_app` (function) — Pytest fixture yielding a TestClient plus its app, built from the test-configured `authed_app` with a seeded admin. <!--#7c0dc10f1bb22800-->
- `test_login_sets_session_cookie_and_me` (function) — Asserts a successful admin login returns admin/local identity, sets an HttpOnly SameSite session cookie, and that `/api/auth/me` then reports the seeded owner. <!--#429d2917d7cfc342-->
- `test_me_requires_authentication` (function) — Asserts `/api/auth/me` returns 401 without a session rather than serving an anonymous identity. <!--#f17ecad4461c2ecb-->
- `test_login_bad_password_is_401` (function) — Asserts a wrong password yields 401 and hands out no session cookie. <!--#b8a4f6e0a0b60bbc-->
- `test_login_unknown_user_is_401` (function) — Asserts logging in as an unknown username yields 401. <!--#cb118bcfd4cb74ed-->
- `test_logout_destroys_session` (function) — Asserts logout returns 200 and that the destroyed session causes subsequent authed calls to fail closed (401). <!--#45aa19e53b5ec9e9-->
- `test_logout_is_idempotent_without_session` (function) — Asserts logout succeeds (200) even with no active session. <!--#baaadd884bcea07c-->
- `test_login_rate_limit_locks_out` (function) — Asserts that exceeding the configured failure threshold trips a lockout returning 429 with a Retry-After header, refusing even the correct password while locked. <!--#3f56a41187aea194-->
- `_put_breakglass` (function) — Test helper that mints a break-glass token via crypto, stores its hash on the app's store, and returns the plaintext. <!--#f5de3ab0c1ee2640-->
- `test_breakglass_mints_admin_session` (function) — Asserts consuming a valid break-glass token mints an admin session that `/api/auth/me` confirms as admin. <!--#1669301e31acec05-->
- `test_breakglass_is_single_admin_subject` (function) — Asserts two break-glass consumptions resolve to the same stable admin owner_id rather than per-token impersonated owners. <!--#563156b29b30146c-->
- `test_breakglass_token_is_one_time` (function) — Asserts a break-glass token works once (200) and cannot be replayed (401). <!--#be21dd5f7485053a-->
- `test_breakglass_invalid_token_is_401` (function) — Asserts an unrecognized break-glass token is rejected with 401. <!--#526c1b0580c2178e-->
- `test_breakglass_empty_token_is_422` (function) — Asserts a blank/whitespace break-glass token fails request validation with 422. <!--#5bf03125ddc7b112-->
- `test_fail_closed_when_no_provider_configured` (function) — Asserts that disabling local with no other provider enabled makes app construction raise `AuthNotConfigured` (fail-closed). <!--#809d5531882c8c01-->
- `test_unauthenticated_reads_are_401` (function) — Asserts core read endpoints (machines/history/flows) all return 401 without authentication. <!--#7803bb114c6421c6-->
- `test_default_session_cookie_is_secure` (function) — Asserts a default (non-test) app issues a Secure, HttpOnly session cookie on login. <!--#3673aa08c5eae3df-->
- `_seed_local_user` (function) — Test helper that directly seeds a local user (owner + local identity binding + hashed password) into the store and returns the owner_id. <!--#5674d0e84e0a685e-->
- `test_admin_creates_user_who_can_then_login` (function) — Asserts an authenticated admin can create a user via `/api/users` and that the new owner/binding/password let that user subsequently log in. <!--#af055871a5f71f76-->
- `test_admin_can_create_another_admin` (function) — Asserts an admin can create another admin user, persisted with `is_admin` true. <!--#6a31868bd3e8f6fa-->
- `test_non_admin_cannot_create_user` (function) — Asserts a non-admin's user-creation request is rejected with 403 and creates no owner. <!--#ec3b96972e1f0295-->
- `test_create_user_requires_authentication` (function) — Asserts unauthenticated `/api/users` creation is 401, confirming no public self-registration. <!--#2530b2d19d6fbf30-->

### `tests/test_server_authz.py` (python) — Test suite verifying server-side owner authorization: daemon-key identity resolution on HELLO, owner-scoped ServerState/UiHub/push/REST views, and fail-closed isolation so owners never see or write each other's machines, flows, or history. <!--#fc9d44249ec01ecd|daa556cd37e9e27a-->
- `_Disconnect` (class) — Exception used by the fake sockets to signal no more queued frames (a client disconnect). <!--#0b594fd2b546acad-->
- `_FakeDaemonWS` (class) — Fake server-side daemon WebSocket driven by a queued frame list, recording sent/accepted/closed state. <!--#82a24bded2f0b1e5-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake daemon socket with queued incoming frames and empty send/accept/close tracking. <!--#b49c06f46d060114-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.accept` (method) — Marks the fake daemon socket as accepted. <!--#5469a86e64b0aac3-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.receive_text` (method) — Pops the next queued frame or raises _Disconnect when none remain. <!--#2531fa1e77e264fb-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.send_text` (method) — Appends a sent frame to the captured-sent list. <!--#a38f8dbb8eeac4a8-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.close` (method) — Marks the fake daemon socket as closed. <!--#d37c335b4328d9f4-->
  - `_FakeDaemonWS.welcomes` (method) — Decodes and returns the WELCOME messages the server sent down this socket. <!--#69b4333785134335-->
- `_FakeUiWS` (class) — Fake web-frontend WebSocket that captures sent payloads as decoded JSON and records close codes. <!--#39fb4b88bd4b7269-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake UI socket with optional queued frames and empty capture state. <!--#c1102799066ad38b-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.accept` (method) — Marks the fake UI socket as accepted. <!--#5469a86e64b0aac3-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.receive_text` (method) — Pops the next queued frame or raises _Disconnect when none remain. <!--#2531fa1e77e264fb-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.send_text` (method) — Appends a sent payload (parsed from JSON) to the captured-sent list. <!--#3e8b5ce5b3c95b3c-->
  - `_FakeUiWS.close` (method) — Marks the fake UI socket as closed and records the close code. <!--#685f43ad573f68aa-->
- `_make_identity_with_key` (function) — Helper that builds an in-memory IdentityService with one owner and an issued daemon key, returning the identity, owner id, and key plaintext. <!--#b0540819cc5f12d6-->
- `test_machine_record_owner_id_in_to_dict` (function) — Asserts MachineRecord carries owner_id and surfaces it (or None) through to_dict in all variants. <!--#c1bfb8a304dc23cf-->
- `test_register_machine_records_owner_id` (function) — Verifies register_machine binds and re-asserts a machine's owner and that get_machine_owner reflects it. <!--#c0a8c0bb1374d661-->
- `test_owner_takeover_on_machine_id_collision_discards_prior_state` (function) — Verifies that an owner change on a reused machine_id scrubs the prior owner's flows and cached history so no cross-owner data leaks. <!--#88d41467cc87bb51-->
- `test_owner_reconnect_same_owner_retains_flows` (function) — Verifies a same-owner reconnect keeps aggregated flows and history (the scrub fires only on owner change). <!--#757fd74b70e3132c-->

- `test_unbound_machine_invisible_to_scoped_view` (function) — Verifies an owner-less machine is fail-closed out of scoped views but still visible to the unscoped/admin view. <!--#4ebdba6acb2474f8-->

- `test_daemon_hello_valid_key_binds_owner_and_accepts` (function) — Verifies a valid-key daemon HELLO is accepted, binds the machine to the resolved owner in state and identity, and never echoes the key. <!--#a1decfe98f421f58-->

### `tests/test_spawn_failed.py` (python) — Test suite for the SPAWN_FAILED feedback channel, covering the protocol message constructor/registration, the daemon client's three spawn/ensure/resume failure paths emitting SPAWN_FAILED frames (and not emitting on success or empty tasks), and the server routing inbound SPAWN_FAILED only to the reporting owner's UI clients. <!--#63efc434a5a935f0|2472fefe739cbb08-->
- `test_make_spawn_failed_payload_and_registration` (function) — Asserts make_spawn_failed builds the correct payload, registers the type as daemon-to-server and known, and round-trips through encode/decode. <!--#83a62a34132b5e25-->
- `test_make_spawn_failed_omits_empty_optionals` (function) — Asserts make_spawn_failed omits unset optional fields (task_description, from_issue_id, resume_flow_id) from the payload. <!--#6d23a9165f4ecc10-->
- `_FakeWS` (class) — Minimal async WebSocket stand-in that decodes and records frames the daemon client sends. <!--#4bcd88a41b8c0413-->
  - `_FakeWS.__init__` (method) — Initializes the fake WebSocket's empty `sent` capture list. <!--#b8b92aad379d234c-->
  - `_FakeWS.send` (method) — Async send that decodes the wire data and appends the resulting message to `sent`. <!--#7d44362527b3e749-->
- `_make_client` (function) — Helper that constructs a DaemonClient with default identity/snapshot args plus per-test handler overrides. <!--#2166366244481ca6-->
- `_spawn_failed_frames` (function) — Helper that filters a fake WS's captured frames down to SPAWN_FAILED messages. <!--#d01cff50f6f9f0cc-->
- `test_fresh_spawn_failure_reports_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies a raising spawn_handler causes one SPAWN_FAILED frame carrying the project root, error text, and task description. <!--#b72184d0d1a3df3d-->
- `test_ensure_error_reports_spawn_failed_and_skips_spawn` (function) — Verifies an ensure_handler returning an error reports SPAWN_FAILED and never invokes the spawn handler. <!--#ce8addba54557ff6-->
- `test_ensure_exception_reports_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies an ensure_handler raising an exception is caught and reported as a SPAWN_FAILED frame. <!--#2c4853ad6b426f7d-->
- `test_resume_failure_reports_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies a raising resume_handler reports SPAWN_FAILED preserving the resume_flow_id and error text. <!--#167f684e5afa5862-->
- `test_successful_spawn_emits_no_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies a successful spawn emits no SPAWN_FAILED frame. <!--#7c4e8621afe61635-->
- `test_empty_task_does_not_report_spawn_failed` (function) — Verifies that dropping an empty/whitespace task at input validation emits no SPAWN_FAILED frame since nothing was launched. <!--#33d2c675d30ffaa4-->
- `test_handle_message_routes_spawn_failed_to_owner_ui` (function) — Verifies the server's _handle_message routes an inbound SPAWN_FAILED only to the reporting machine owner's UI clients and not to other owners. <!--#d8f6e612fe622d83-->

### `tests/test_spec_write_fallback.py` (python) — Test suite verifying the spec-write diff guard: non-exempt IMPLEMENT steps that write or create spec files are FAILED with their illegal edits reverted and a guiding error, while UPDATE_SPEC and sync_* steps are exempt, the guard respects the spec_write_protection.diff_fallback_enabled config, and pre-existing handler errors are preserved. <!--#798cb9b0f7a63249|bcfdc05e54ea5417-->

  - `TestConfigDisable.test_decision_helper_off_when_disabled` (method) — Asserts _spec_diff_guard_enabled returns False for an implement step when config disables the fallback. <!--#331e166221083511-->

### `tests/test_spec_write_protection.py` (python) — End-to-end regression suite for the spec-write-protection soft layer, asserting the derived SPEC_WRITE_ALLOWED_STEPS exemption set and its sync sub-sets, the injection hit/miss matrix and its post-charter-refactor wording, that LLMCaller.call() weaves the constraint only into protected steps' prompts, and that the charter refactor removed the plan step's dedicated spec-protection section and spec-governance machinery. <!--#7ba15257f96db37f|d0dd45d93485a91e-->

  - `TestUsageTotals.test_is_empty_false_when_only_cost` (method) — Verifies a nonzero cost alone makes is_empty() return False. <!--#5d019dd1d46a2c9b-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_is_empty_false_when_only_tokens` (method) — Verifies a nonzero token count alone makes is_empty() return False. <!--#94808f679d609a72-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_to_dict_is_json_primitive` (method) — Verifies to_dict() emits the expected key/value map with only JSON-primitive numeric values. <!--#18933039f07692f6-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_round_trip` (method) — Verifies from_dict(to_dict(u)) reconstructs an equal UsageTotals. <!--#d86fde01ec57b51d-->

  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_empty` (method) — Verifies from_dict({}) yields a default (empty) UsageTotals. <!--#d25f321f967c2339-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_missing_fields_default_zero` (method) — Verifies from_dict fills absent fields with zero while keeping provided ones. <!--#4cf3a7a77c656d5f-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_none_values_coerce_to_zero` (method) — Verifies from_dict coerces explicit None field values to zero. <!--#618b6bfce55b5d69-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_bad_values_coerce_to_zero` (method) — Verifies from_dict coerces non-numeric (unparseable) field values to zero. <!--#17dd3ef86ec0b72e-->
  - `TestUsageTotals.test_from_dict_numeric_strings` (method) — Verifies from_dict parses numeric-string field values into their numeric types. <!--#e856df73945b94b9-->
- `TestFormatting` (class) — Tests for the format_cost and format_usage_line display helpers, including their None/bad-input safety. <!--#c34831a354285e26-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_cost` (method) — Verifies format_cost renders a USD amount to four decimal places with a dollar sign. <!--#e2cdb4551149c66b-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_cost_none_safe` (method) — Verifies format_cost(None) returns the zero-cost string. <!--#2f49f442d343bf75-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_cost_bad_value_safe` (method) — Verifies format_cost on an unparseable value returns the zero-cost string. <!--#a0d166a2bb470167-->

  - `TestFormatting.test_format_usage_line_none_safe` (method) — Verifies format_usage_line(None) renders a zeroed line without error. <!--#4a3236797cfad026-->
  - `TestFormatting.test_format_usage_line_empty_safe` (method) — Verifies format_usage_line on an empty UsageTotals renders the zero-cost line. <!--#d83460b5e44a1638-->
- `TestStepScopedAccumulator` (class) — Tests for the contextvars-based step usage scope (accumulate_step_usage / add_call_usage / current_step_usage), covering accumulation, nesting, isolation, and restoration. <!--#173ae0abb738c5e9-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_no_scope_current_is_none` (method) — Verifies current_step_usage() is None when no scope is active. <!--#8b770ffd65d213b4-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_add_call_usage_outside_scope_is_noop` (method) — Verifies add_call_usage is a safe no-op when called with no active scope. <!--#cf6e53dc79d69217-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_accumulates_multiple_calls` (method) — Verifies an active scope sums multiple add_call_usage contributions into its accumulator. <!--#ae2a81908169b5bf-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_accepts_dict_usage` (method) — Verifies add_call_usage accepts plain dict/mapping usage payloads within a scope. <!--#99d3b5b792aa2bbf-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_add_call_usage_ignores_none_and_garbage` (method) — Verifies add_call_usage silently ignores None and non-usage values while still folding valid ones. <!--#84ba9869d9645313-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_restored_after_exit` (method) — Verifies the active scope is cleared back to None after the context manager exits. <!--#59fa3846028df6bb-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_nested_scopes_isolated` (method) — Verifies nested scopes are isolated so inner usage does not leak into the outer accumulator. <!--#b664adca4fba95a8-->
  - `TestStepScopedAccumulator.test_scope_restored_on_exception` (method) — Verifies the scope is restored to None even when the body raises an exception. <!--#1fa78021c116e851-->
- `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread` (class) — Tests for use_step_usage re-binding a parent accumulator across thread boundaries, the fix for DAG-parallel workers dropping usage in fresh contextvars contexts. <!--#ac6aae1c28ce9619-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_use_step_usage_none_is_noop` (method) — Verifies use_step_usage(None) binds no scope and leaves add_call_usage a no-op. <!--#c6d75453b36fd5ed-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_use_step_usage_binds_existing_accumulator` (method) — Verifies use_step_usage binds a given accumulator so contributions fold into it, then unbinds on exit. <!--#e0cabeb598eff632-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_worker_thread_without_rebind_does_not_see_scope` (method) — Reproduces the bug where a bare worker thread sees no scope and its usage is discarded. <!--#9c8450d64dfa4818-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_worker_thread_with_rebind_folds_into_parent` (method) — Verifies the fix where workers re-bind the captured accumulator via use_step_usage so their usage folds into the parent. <!--#aa468b0a544eab98-->
  - `TestUseStepUsageCrossThread.test_concurrent_folds_are_not_lost` (method) — Verifies many threads concurrently folding into one shared accumulator lose no updates due to serialized read-modify-write. <!--#3f756857e7e807ad-->

### `tests/test_tool_formatters.py` (python) — Unit tests for the tool-call preview formatters, covering the generic truncate_preview/fallback renderers and per-tool use/result formatters (Edit, Write, Read, Bash, Grep, Glob) for paths, line counts, truncation, and success/error display. <!--#2cd41d4676b2acd5|dec7cf394fa08963-->
- `TestTruncatePreview` (class) — Tests for truncate_preview, verifying length capping, ellipsis handling, newline replacement, and default max length. <!--#2cee7d755496bf5f-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_empty_string` (method) — Empty input returns an empty string. <!--#329321bda3b6d25e-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_none_is_falsy` (method) — None input is treated as falsy and returns an empty string. <!--#d7102da74b56b9d2-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_short_text_unchanged` (method) — Text shorter than max_length is returned unchanged. <!--#27716f841cc2a3c2-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_exact_length_unchanged` (method) — Text exactly at max_length is returned unchanged. <!--#09565ab1fa1bb605-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_long_text_truncated` (method) — Overlong text is truncated to max_length with a trailing ellipsis. <!--#8a412aa0f6785841-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_newlines_replaced` (method) — Newlines in the text are replaced with spaces. <!--#25c4a5aa3d166145-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_custom_ellipsis` (method) — A custom ellipsis string is honored while still respecting max_length. <!--#8e51466d644d9b3b-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_very_short_max_length` (method) — A very small max_length still yields output of exactly that length. <!--#8baf8feefbfa15b5-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_default_max_length_is_60` (method) — The default max_length is 60 characters. <!--#7f76d4bad14df978-->

### `tests/test_transitive_reduction.py` (python) — Unit test suite for the transitive_reduce algorithm, covering empty/edge-case inputs, graphs with no redundant edges, removal of redundant transitive edges, input immutability, and preservation of extra fields and group ordering. <!--#1e7ab994e7cebc6a|869eab9a07c73c40-->
- `TestTransitiveReduceEmpty` (class) — Test class verifying transitive_reduce handles empty, single-group, and missing-depends_on-key inputs gracefully. <!--#7b69b3acd6043798-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceEmpty.test_empty_groups` (method) — Asserts that reducing an empty list of groups returns an empty list. <!--#1f7509546b6fd20b-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceEmpty.test_single_group_no_deps` (method) — Asserts a single group with no dependencies passes through unchanged. <!--#e7b5f6f178778cb5-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceEmpty.test_single_group_missing_depends_on_key` (method) — Asserts a group lacking a depends_on key is preserved without that key being added. <!--#cc36462721d248b0-->
- `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange` (class) — Test class verifying graphs with no redundant edges (linear chains, diamonds, independent groups) are returned unchanged. <!--#d779151c586f3030-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_linear_chain_minimal` (method) — Asserts a minimal A→B→C chain with no redundant edges is unchanged. <!--#1bb1243b56655b1f-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_diamond_not_reducible` (method) — Asserts a diamond's two independent edges into D are both essential and not reduced. <!--#b9399ca447fc1374-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_two_independent_groups` (method) — Asserts two unconnected groups each retain empty dependencies. <!--#d21a215a0b5e578e-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceNoChange.test_two_groups_single_edge` (method) — Asserts a single non-redundant edge between two groups is preserved. <!--#46378998972ebc74-->
- `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant` (class) — Test class verifying redundant transitive edges are removed across chains, complex DAGs, and multi-root structures. <!--#b78a583848180213-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_linear_chain_with_shortcut` (method) — Asserts a direct A→C edge is dropped when C is already reachable via A→B→C. <!--#ec21bdf86bf1c2d6-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_longer_chain_with_skip` (method) — Asserts redundant A and B edges into D collapse to just C in a four-node chain. <!--#3e5bccb3bbb3fb56-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_complex_dag_multiple_redundancies` (method) — Asserts the redundant A→D shortcut is removed while essential B→D and C→D edges remain. <!--#b48ada9dda1caa02-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_wide_fan_in_with_chain` (method) — Asserts both A→D and B→D shortcuts are removed when D is reachable through the C chain. <!--#26683ab239e65f3d-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceRedundant.test_multiple_roots_with_redundancy` (method) — Asserts redundant root edges (R1, R2) into C are removed, leaving only A and B. <!--#d018e44a6c07a5f0-->
- `TestTransitiveReduceImmutability` (class) — Test class verifying transitive_reduce does not mutate its input and returns fresh objects. <!--#42856ab8b4a25552-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceImmutability.test_does_not_mutate_input` (method) — Asserts the input groups list is unchanged after reduction by comparing against a deep copy. <!--#f24a0f4ca27664b4-->
  - `TestTransitiveReduceImmutability.test_returned_list_is_new_object` (method) — Asserts the returned list and its group dicts are new objects, not the inputs. <!--#c3748e7d3153390d-->
- `TestTransitiveReducePreservesFields` (class) — Test class verifying extra group fields and input ordering survive reduction. <!--#aea212cd65523f99-->
  - `TestTransitiveReducePreservesFields.test_extra_keys_preserved` (method) — Asserts non-dependency keys like name and tasks are preserved in the reduced output. <!--#31208ba89d2f1b42-->
  - `TestTransitiveReducePreservesFields.test_group_order_preserved` (method) — Asserts the output list preserves the input group order. <!--#ecbe42e4cab7d630-->

### `tests/test_worktree_history_sidecar.py` (python) — Test suite pinning the DaemonHistoryReader's `--worktree` history sidecar-merging fix, verifying that primary `.jsonl` files and their `*.jsonl.from-<branch>` sidecars are merged under one logical step id with correct ordering, no loss/duplication, proper step-type parsing, and accurate incremental cursor advancement (including mid-write tail handling). <!--#432d060b5c2a7b0c|e51323d43fee0a05-->

- `test_parse_step_type_strips_sidecar_suffix` (function) — Verifies `parse_step_type_from_step_id` extracts the step type from logical ids as well as raw primary/sidecar file names. <!--#c8102b38ca7efffe-->
- `test_iter_history_jsonl_includes_sidecars_sorted` (function) — Asserts `_iter_history_jsonl` enumerates both primary files and their sidecars in sorted order. <!--#ea418105857d9ccf-->

- `test_read_flow_merges_primary_and_sidecar` (function) — Verifies `read_flow` merges a primary file and its sidecar under one step id in order with no loss/duplication and a per-physical-file cursor. <!--#1ae83b4c342844e0-->

- `test_read_flow_multiple_sidecars_for_one_step` (function) — Verifies several hash-disambiguated sidecars for one step all merge in order with each physical file tracked independently in the cursor. <!--#68381faf8326123c-->

### `tests/test_worktree_project_exclusion.py` (python) — Test suite verifying that se3 worktree copies are correctly resolved to their main project root and excluded from project discovery, issue aggregation, process scanning, and the persisted project registry, using helper fixtures and psutil test doubles. <!--#ffc2e97dccae4a55|edbb91e3380f410c-->

- `test_resolve_returns_none_for_plain_project` (function) — Asserts a plain (non-worktree) project root resolves to None and is not flagged as a worktree copy. <!--#a9dc2883c766b611-->
- `test_resolve_nested_worktree_stops_at_immediate_parent` (function) — Asserts a nested worktree resolves to its immediate parent root rather than the outermost root. <!--#751307a08c585539-->
- `test_resolve_skips_non_worktree_structure` (function) — Asserts paths not shaped like <main>/se3/worktrees/<name> (and empty paths) are left alone, returning None. <!--#16d0796ca952484e-->

  - `_FakePsutil.__init__` (method) — Stores the fixed list of fake processes to be returned by process_iter. <!--#683a9b76f6799f49-->

- `test_scan_external_registers_main_root_for_worktree_proc` (function) — Asserts the supervisor's external scan attributes a worktree-running se3 process to the main root, not the worktree path. <!--#2401425fde00305e-->
- `test_collect_issues_skips_worktree_copy` (function) — Asserts the aggregator collects issues from the main root but returns none for a worktree copy. <!--#0c5917003435a3ce-->
- `test_snapshot_does_not_double_count_worktree_issues` (function) — Asserts a worktree run surfaces as a flow card yet its cloned issues are counted once and its copy dir is not a standalone project. <!--#d0ba1a971d4d15a0-->
- `test_worktree_root_excluded_from_project_roots` (function) — Asserts the snapshot's dropdown-facing project_roots lists the main root but never the worktree copy. <!--#afc5a221a5571342-->
- `test_entry_point_seam_keeps_worktree_out_of_active_and_registry` (function) — Asserts driving a worktree path through the live Daemon's aggregator keeps it out of both the active set and the persisted registry. <!--#5b0067546e7a983d-->
- `test_append_project_root_defence_normalizes_worktree` (function) — Asserts the disk-write backstop folds an appended worktree path to its main root in the registry. <!--#9f2db23a139d97cd-->
- `test_startup_sanitize_cleans_polluted_registry_to_main_only` (function) — Asserts the one-time startup sanitize rewrites a worktree-polluted registry to contain only the main root. <!--#78f44ac31b0a9d78-->
- `test_startup_sanitize_clean_registry_not_rewritten` (function) — Asserts a registry with no worktree pollution is left byte-for-byte untouched (mtime unchanged) by sanitize. <!--#5910e04cdcb9d3da-->

### `tests/test_worktree_registry_seam.py` (python) — Test suite verifying that transient worktree paths (under <main>/se3/worktrees/) are normalized back to their main project root at the DaemonAggregator.add_project_root seam and its disk-write/sanitize backstops, so they never leak into the displayed project-root set or persist in the on-disk registry across daemon restarts. <!--#bff3f32849cb1219|1ab79b2838871912-->
