- `test_all_entry_points_normalize_through_seam` (function) — Asserts that driving a worktree path through the shared aggregator seam normalizes both the in-memory set and the on-disk registry, covering all five registration entry points. <!--#c277da825f3abaa1-->
- `test_append_project_root_normalizes_worktree` (function) — Asserts the disk write point _append_project_root folds a worktree path back to its main root before persisting. <!--#b7aead7edb298071-->
- `test_sanitize_removes_worktree_entry` (function) — Asserts _sanitize_project_roots cleans and rewrites a registry already polluted with a worktree-copy entry. <!--#5228f62244a4d53c-->
- `test_sanitize_no_change_leaves_file_untouched` (function) — Asserts _sanitize_project_roots leaves an already-clean registry file unwritten (mtime unchanged). <!--#db62dc439fced750-->
- `test_sanitize_missing_file_is_noop` (function) — Asserts _sanitize_project_roots is a fault-tolerant no-op when the registry file does not exist. <!--#7ff3f36d1a7bfdcb-->
- `test_sanitize_corrupt_file_is_noop` (function) — Asserts a corrupt registry file reads as empty and is left untouched by _sanitize_project_roots. <!--#12444e2d6cb24515-->
- `test_daemon_init_sanitizes_on_startup` (function) — Asserts Daemon construction runs the one-time registry sanitize, purging pre-existing worktree entries on startup. <!--#9f2ccf15bacf0701-->
- `test_worktree_observable_but_not_registered` (function) — Asserts a worktree remains visible via the run-roots observable channel yet never appears in the displayed project-root set after normalization. <!--#bd2cc3d2fbf7d1db-->

### `tests/test_worktree_seam_regression.py` (python) — Regression test suite guarding the worktree observability seam, verifying that an eager-saved worktree-mode flow persists is_worktree_mode/worktree_path at INIT and is observable and live-readable during discovery startup, while DAG isolation worktrees and the seam worktree itself never enter the active set, registry, or project root list. <!--#f030fab550b0c0df|a4e7120863d927e4-->
- `_eager_save_worktree_flow` (function) — Test helper that mimics the run command's eager save by creating a pending worktree-mode flow and immediately persisting its engine.json at status INIT. <!--#1c56a9651dab0d1a-->
- `test_eager_save_persists_is_worktree_mode_at_init` (function) — Asserts the eager save writes an engine.json carrying is_worktree_mode and worktree_path at status INIT before any discovery LLM call. <!--#76c38c312ac1b1b0-->
- `test_worktree_observable_at_discovery_startup_window` (function) — Verifies the eager-saved worktree is admitted to the observable root set at INIT yet stays out of the dropdown-facing project root list. <!--#bcb044e5517e7ad0-->
- `test_discovery_first_reply_read_live_at_init` (function) — Checks that a complete-but-unterminated discovery first reply reads live and is indexed as active from the INIT engine.json, then keeps appending incrementally on cursor reads. <!--#b756ce7b72c32b66-->
- `test_dag_isolation_worktree_stays_excluded` (function) — Guards that a DAG implement-isolation worktree (no top-level is_worktree_mode record) remains excluded from the observable set despite sharing the worktrees parent. <!--#2d6b1ed0233c6fd1-->
- `test_seam_observable_and_readable_yet_never_registered` (function) — Single bidirectional-guard test asserting both seam invariants at once — the worktree is observable/readable (Bug1) yet never enters the active set, registry, or project list (Bug2). <!--#e5f3fa7072c4b369-->

## `tests/commands/` — Test package for se3 CLI commands, bundling unit and integration suites for the `se3 run` command (flow execution, resume/interrupt handling, failure-action resolution, preset selection, and worktree isolation mode) alongside a `merge/` subpackage that hardens every layer of the `se3 merge` pipeline. <!--#11838e7f07865e45|9f5e8dfcf76fed65-->

### `tests/commands/__init__.py` (python) — Package initializer marking the directory of unit tests for se3 CLI commands. <!--#2e351cd9cd7e4289|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/commands/test_run.py` (python) — Unit tests for the `se3 run` command's flow execution, covering resume detection for interrupted RUNNING and FAILED steps, the interactive resume menu, Ctrl-C step-interrupt interjection handling, and `--output-format` CLI-vs-NDJSON event-stream wiring. <!--#5a89f6f8ead9818a|5358f62ddfd91fb1-->
- `TestResumeDetection` (class) — Test class verifying `run_flow`'s resume logic for interrupted RUNNING steps, including rejection of completed flows/snapshots and injection of the `resumed` flag. <!--#1edd75e1e1cb4f82-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.setup_method` (method) — Builds a temp project with a RUNNING flow whose IMPLEMENT step was interrupted mid-execution and persists it for resume tests. <!--#38e9e031921e252d-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#f17fb20a9042d3fa-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_detects_running_step_and_transitions_to_pending` (method) — Asserts that resuming a flow flips its interrupted RUNNING step back to PENDING for re-execution. <!--#c5536b7760172c91-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_rejects_completed_active_flow` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED flow loaded from engine.json is refused (returns 1) and never dispatched to the state machine. <!--#72f4b2e57e506259-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_rejects_completed_snapshot_flow` (method) — Asserts a stale COMPLETED per-flow resumable snapshot is not resurrected, saved back, or dispatched. <!--#e4b2b86536743fe0-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_injects_resumed_flag_into_step_inputs` (method) — Asserts resuming sets `inputs["resumed"]=True` on the interrupted step. <!--#63a8238e320c8366-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_normal_run_does_not_trigger_resume_logic` (method) — Asserts a fresh run without a flow_id creates a new flow rather than entering resume logic. <!--#5ae36a2dcb4bcdfb-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_preserves_existing_step_outputs` (method) — Asserts partial step outputs survive resume while the `resumed` flag is added to inputs (not outputs). <!--#13a9fb95e1959ee8-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_with_non_running_step_does_not_modify_status` (method) — Asserts resuming a step that is already PENDING leaves its status unchanged and injects no `resumed` flag. <!--#f31300a5372711af-->
  - `TestResumeDetection.test_resume_logs_interrupted_step_info` (method) — Asserts resume emits a log line identifying the interrupted step being resumed. <!--#1bcd122b3e713175-->
- `TestResumeFailedFlow` (class) — Test class verifying `run_flow`'s resume path for FAILED flows (retry-from-breakpoint behavior). <!--#cb4689624eb631c7-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.setup_method` (method) — Builds a temp project with a FAILED flow whose IMPLEMENT step exhausted its retries and persists it. <!--#1c5d6ce8cfafc752-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#f17fb20a9042d3fa-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_step_transitions_to_pending` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED step transitions it back to PENDING. <!--#e4582a313c99ae45-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_resets_flow_status_to_running` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED flow resets the flow status to RUNNING before re-execution. <!--#9a6f2c07426f691f-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_resets_retry_count` (method) — Asserts the step model's `retry_count` is reset to 0 on resuming a FAILED step. <!--#bc0b99d320959c1c-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_increments_input_retry_count` (method) — Asserts the input `retry_count` is incremented (for conversation history) and the `resumed` flag set on a FAILED resume. <!--#ab40bd09c916975c-->
  - `TestResumeFailedFlow.test_resume_failed_logs_retry_info` (method) — Asserts resuming a FAILED step logs a retry-from-breakpoint message naming the step. <!--#c5b0aacebfdc4834-->
- `TestHandleResumeInteractiveFailedFlows` (class) — Test class verifying the interactive resume menu includes FAILED flows, excludes COMPLETED ones, and shows a retry label. <!--#f50d84bb9d8c0e14-->
  - `TestHandleResumeInteractiveFailedFlows.test_failed_flow_appears_in_resume_menu` (method) — Asserts a FAILED flow is offered in the interactive resume menu and its id returned on selection. <!--#48b4b08de4acc444-->
  - `TestHandleResumeInteractiveFailedFlows.test_completed_flow_excluded_from_resume_menu` (method) — Asserts a COMPLETED flow is omitted from the resume menu (returns None). <!--#eab01f70ea8dd53f-->
  - `TestHandleResumeInteractiveFailedFlows.test_failed_flow_shows_retry_label` (method) — Asserts the menu renders a 'failed'/retry action label for a FAILED flow. <!--#d5828bc6df5bfe5a-->
- `TestHandleStepInterrupt` (class) — Test class verifying `_handle_step_interrupt` persists Ctrl-C user interjections to flow context and inlines them into the step's task_description without duplicating sections. <!--#218ba334416a24b5-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt._make_flow_and_step` (method) — Helper that builds a RUNNING flow and IMPLEMENT step seeded with a base task_description for interrupt tests. <!--#eb7933be8912fd4a-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_user_input_persists_to_context_and_step_inputs` (method) — Asserts a non-empty interjection is saved to flow context and appended under a single `## Additional Instructions` section in the step inputs. <!--#a1622b70b83f7de5-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_repeated_interjections_compose_against_original_base` (method) — Asserts a second interjection composes against the original base, yielding both bullets under one section header (no nesting). <!--#21baf063966c2a4b-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_empty_input_does_not_persist_or_modify` (method) — Asserts an empty interjection leaves context and task_description untouched while still resetting the step to PENDING for retry. <!--#f1962e262328a342-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_interrupt_on_later_step_does_not_double_section` (method) — Regression test asserting an interrupt on a later step whose task_description already carries a composed section does not double the `## Additional Instructions` header. <!--#297f231b4a01a0d2-->
  - `TestHandleStepInterrupt.test_cancelled_input_returns_none` (method) — Asserts cancelling the interjection prompt saves the flow, returns None, and leaves the step RUNNING with no interjection. <!--#af3e7e5e1dada8b3-->
- `TestOutputFormatEventStream` (class) — Test class verifying the `--output-format` wiring: CLI mode renders via the Rich step renderer while JSON mode emits NDJSON lifecycle events. <!--#8656e7c47d9ec475-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.setup_method` (method) — Builds a temp project with a single-IMPLEMENT-step RUNNING flow and persists it for output-format tests. <!--#de8c4248047e2fb0-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temporary project directory after each test. <!--#c34398a3746e8dbf-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream._run` (method) — Helper that runs `run_flow` with a mocked state machine (mirroring the real STEP_STARTED emission) under a given output format. <!--#3d8030d8244c42d5-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.test_json_mode_emits_valid_ndjson` (method) — Asserts JSON mode writes the full flow lifecycle (flow_started/step_started/step_completed/flow_completed) as parseable NDJSON. <!--#0d712aaf27148a5a-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.test_cli_mode_routes_step_output_through_renderer` (method) — Asserts default CLI mode routes step output through `step_renderers.render_step_output` exactly once. <!--#5fa5dcd54fa70f9a-->
  - `TestOutputFormatEventStream.test_json_mode_does_not_call_cli_renderer` (method) — Asserts JSON mode bypasses the Rich step renderer entirely. <!--#0f623c237a23a6a7-->
- `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination` (class) — Test class locking in the `se3 run --discover --from-issue <id>` CLI contract: discovery task type, issue linkage, and issue lifecycle. <!--#4f0bfe0a1fe17e7d-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination._make_project_with_issue` (method) — Helper that initializes a git project and creates a human-sourced issue for the CLI tests. <!--#2653f174e90da231-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination._invoke` (method) — Helper that invokes the `se3 run` CLI via Typer's CliRunner with `get_project_root` and `run_flow` patched. <!--#92b2326511edeb44-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_discover_from_issue_passes_discovery_task_type` (method) — Asserts `--discover --from-issue` forces task_type=discovery while preserving the issue description, source linkage, and non-worktree mode. <!--#ef9ffbb903adfc79-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_from_issue_without_discover_keeps_default_type` (method) — Asserts `--from-issue` alone keeps the default 'feature' type while preserving the issue source linkage. <!--#8180f65edca1ae04-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_discover_from_issue_runs_issue_lifecycle` (method) — Asserts a successful `--discover --from-issue` run resolves the source issue (lifecycle intact). <!--#2010118b42aa7abb-->
  - `TestDiscoverFromIssueCombination.test_from_issue_help_mentions_discover_combination` (method) — Asserts the `run --help` text documents the discovery-step combination. <!--#2288eb2b2626ba40-->

### `tests/commands/test_run_failure_action.py` (python) — Unit tests for the retry_decision mutual-exclusion between CLI TTY and webui, covering `_resolve_step_failure_action`'s interactive/non-interactive paths (adopting or racing a webui-written response) and the `_cleanup_retry_decision_artifacts` helper that wipes the call file and both sibling response variants after the CLI answers. <!--#e432d735aa1ddf02|da5a765665f0b15b-->
- `_stub_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal SimpleNamespace flow stub carrying just a `flow_id`. <!--#7fad2141f541dc2b-->
- `_stub_step` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal SimpleNamespace step stub with `step_id`, a `step_type.value`, and `retry_count`. <!--#de45daacf3680ab8-->
- `test_interactive_with_existing_response_returns_decision_and_cleans_up` (function) — Asserts that on an interactive terminal with a webui-written response present, the resolver adopts the decision and deletes the call file and both sibling response variants. <!--#494525dc9923c8fd-->
- `test_interactive_without_response_returns_race_and_writes_call` (function) — Asserts that interactive with no webui answer returns a 'race' action and writes a retry_decision call file (the webui chip) without consuming any response. <!--#316bbd149addec38-->
- `test_non_interactive_with_existing_response_unchanged` (function) — Asserts the unchanged non-interactive path: first pass writes the call and pauses, then after the webui answers a second pass adopts the decision and cleans up. <!--#bf09076e792d8b4b-->
- `test_non_interactive_without_response_pauses` (function) — Asserts non-interactive with no answer writes a retry_decision-kind call file and returns a 'pause' action. <!--#845e7e1500361f06-->
- `test_interactive_unrecognized_decision_defaults_to_abort` (function) — Asserts a garbled webui decision payload is treated as 'abort' but still consumed and its call file removed. <!--#6fec1394558cfb5c-->
- `test_cleanup_helper_removes_all_three_artifacts` (function) — Asserts `_cleanup_retry_decision_artifacts` removes the call file plus both `.response` and `.response.json` sibling variants after the CLI prompt answers. <!--#85b44953a6b1d2c6-->
- `test_cleanup_helper_is_noop_when_nothing_exists` (function) — Asserts the cleanup helper is a quiet, idempotent no-op when no calls directory or artifacts exist. <!--#d539e3ef1539d3f0-->
- `test_cleanup_targets_only_deterministic_retry_decision_file` (function) — Asserts cleanup deletes only the deterministic retry_decision call file, leaving other call kinds (e.g. a plain confirm call) in the same calls directory intact. <!--#540d93edaa542c0d-->

### `tests/commands/test_run_preset.py` (python) — Pytest integration suite for the `se3 run --preset` CLI mechanism, verifying preset/type mutual exclusivity, unknown-preset error listing, prompt-and-type forwarding to run_flow, missing-prompt-file errors, two-layer preset listing, and project-over-builtin override. <!--#15e69234dd0dd479|f538642fc6c61a11-->
- `project_root` (function) — Pytest fixture returning a bare tmp_path directory used as the patched project root for each test. <!--#f14a7a57a646fa9e-->
- `_invoke` (function) — Helper that invokes the CLI `run` command with `get_project_root` and `run_flow` patched, returning the result and the run_flow mock. <!--#3f2640baa5d88944-->
- `_write_project_doc_sync` (function) — Helper that writes a project-level `doc-sync` preset (prompt file plus se3.yaml entry) into the given root to exercise overriding the built-in preset. <!--#0b02c9f7514490e7-->
- `test_preset_and_type_mutually_exclusive` (function) — Asserts that passing both `--preset` and `--type` fails with a 'mutually exclusive' error and never calls run_flow. <!--#1883960b2cd45378-->
- `test_unknown_preset_lists_available` (function) — Asserts that an unknown preset name exits with code 1 and lists available presets (including the built-in doc-sync). <!--#e104f3e996ca5d8d-->
- `test_preset_type_and_prompt_reach_run_flow` (function) — Asserts that the built-in doc-sync preset's type and full prompt text are forwarded to run_flow as task_type and task_description. <!--#baf7cecba3767202-->
- `test_missing_prompt_file_errors` (function) — Asserts that a preset declaring a non-existent prompt_file fails with a 'missing' error rather than silently succeeding. <!--#6df8493bc8220cf4-->
- `test_preset_list_shows_both_layers` (function) — Asserts that `--preset list` shows both built-in and project presets, each labeled with its source layer. <!--#f7ad74e821506bec-->
- `test_project_preset_overrides_builtin` (function) — Asserts that a project-level doc-sync preset overrides the built-in one, with its marker text reaching run_flow's task_description. <!--#9695f443a304e2f6-->

### `tests/commands/test_run_worktree_mode.py` (python) — Unit tests for `se3 run --worktree` isolation mode in run.py, covering branch-name slug helpers, main-repo MergeLock acquisition/deferral/release, run_worktree_mode orchestration (fork → run_flow → merge-back on success or preserve on failure/pause), and discovery plus lock-free resume of interrupted worktree runs. <!--#2ffc2a741642f074|37abc9fe6d743e46-->
- `TestBranchNameHelpers` (class) — Tests the slugify and worktree-branch-name generation helpers used to derive a branch from a task description. <!--#c5f0bce3c9d56342-->
  - `TestBranchNameHelpers.test_slugify_basic` (method) — Asserts _slugify_for_branch lowercases, drops punctuation, and hyphenates a normal task string. <!--#ba6a8a5ce922ae7d-->
  - `TestBranchNameHelpers.test_slugify_collapses_and_trims` (method) — Asserts _slugify_for_branch collapses runs of separators and trims leading/trailing junk. <!--#b080cead3111a330-->
  - `TestBranchNameHelpers.test_slugify_empty_falls_back_to_task` (method) — Asserts _slugify_for_branch returns the literal 'task' when the input slugifies to empty. <!--#694270524ccee34a-->
  - `TestBranchNameHelpers.test_slugify_truncates_to_30` (method) — Asserts _slugify_for_branch caps the slug length at 30 characters. <!--#af4f4f428d296548-->
  - `TestBranchNameHelpers.test_generate_worktree_branch_name_shape` (method) — Asserts _generate_worktree_branch_name produces a 'worktree/<slug>-<suffix>' name with exactly one slash. <!--#bd626727aa7fbf02-->
- `TestRunFlowMainLock` (class) — Tests how run_flow builds, defers acquisition of, threads through, and always releases the main-repo MergeLock. <!--#92c722af925e91ff-->
  - `TestRunFlowMainLock.test_sync_run_defers_acquire_and_releases_lock` (method) — Verifies a synchronous run builds the lock on the resolved main root, defers acquire to the impl, hands the lock through, and releases on exit. <!--#11d953a91ec14ec7-->
  - `TestRunFlowMainLock.test_worktree_body_takes_no_lock` (method) — Verifies a worktree-body run (acquire_main_lock=False) never constructs a MergeLock. <!--#5d015f130038836f-->
  - `TestRunFlowMainLock.test_lock_released_even_when_impl_raises` (method) — Verifies the lock is released even when the underlying _run_flow_impl raises. <!--#609ed768e5498c91-->
- `TestRunWorktreeMode` (class) — Tests run_worktree_mode end-to-end: fork → run_flow in the worktree → merge-back on success, preserve on failure/pause, and pidfile lifecycle. <!--#35101d77456cecfd-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeMode.test_success_merges_back` (method) — Verifies a successful run forks off the current branch, runs lock-free in worktree mode, and merges the isolation branch back into the main repo. <!--#a33ca564f7325a79-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeMode.test_failure_preserves_and_skips_merge` (method) — Verifies a non-zero run_flow return is propagated and no merge-back is attempted. <!--#09785efa606835ac-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeMode.test_paused_json_flow_skips_merge` (method) — Verifies a run_flow that returns 0 but leaves on-disk status PAUSED is not merged (avoiding loss of the paused flow). <!--#eef1951fd529d72c-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeMode.test_worktree_creation_failure_returns_error` (method) — Verifies a fork_worktree failure causes run_worktree_mode to return error code 1. <!--#d75b887f4222f144-->
  - `TestRunWorktreeMode.test_run_pidfile_survives_into_trailing_merge` (method) — Regression test ensuring the worktree's run.pid marker persists across both the flow body and the trailing merge and is only cleared after the run fully returns. <!--#60c356f9529cf522-->
- `_write_worktree_engine_json` (function) — Test helper that writes a worktree-mode engine.json fixture under se3/worktrees/.../se3/state and returns its data dict. <!--#a3faf39dd386e268-->
- `TestWorktreeRunDiscovery` (class) — Tests find_resumable_worktree_runs scanning for incomplete, worktree-mode engine.json files. <!--#7858c6cdcb782020-->
  - `TestWorktreeRunDiscovery.test_find_resumable_worktree_runs` (method) — Verifies a failed worktree run is discovered with its id, worktree flag, and branch metadata. <!--#7445ae57d587bf18-->
  - `TestWorktreeRunDiscovery.test_completed_worktree_run_excluded` (method) — Verifies a completed worktree run is excluded from resumable discovery. <!--#3bb8e480f4104f57-->
  - `TestWorktreeRunDiscovery.test_non_worktree_engine_json_ignored` (method) — Verifies engine.json files without is_worktree_mode set are ignored by discovery. <!--#66b41ccaa5400aef-->
  - `TestWorktreeRunDiscovery.test_no_worktrees_dir` (method) — Verifies discovery returns empty when no worktrees directory exists. <!--#28851cbefcab1f9d-->
- `TestResumeRun` (class) — Tests resume_run routing: plain main-repo resume vs. lock-free worktree resume followed by a trailing merge, including the worktree-as-project-root case. <!--#73d9eddb39aaad5b-->
  - `TestResumeRun.test_resume_main_repo_flow` (method) — Verifies resuming with no worktree runs dispatches a plain main-repo resume that keeps the default (locked) behavior. <!--#e67c8165548d1775-->
  - `TestResumeRun.test_resume_worktree_run_then_merge` (method) — Verifies resuming a worktree run re-dispatches the body lock-free in the worktree and merges back on success. <!--#f9f32f931d804051-->
  - `TestResumeRun.test_resume_worktree_run_failure_skips_merge` (method) — Verifies a failed worktree resume propagates the return code and skips the trailing merge. <!--#40c2b6e88d145d29-->
  - `TestResumeRun.test_resume_worktree_run_paused_again_skips_merge` (method) — Verifies a worktree resume that pauses again (status stays PAUSED) returns 0 but performs no merge. <!--#59e34856d21bbfd5-->
  - `TestResumeRun.test_resume_when_project_root_is_the_worktree_itself` (method) — Verifies a daemon resume whose project_root is the worktree itself runs lock-free there but drives the merge from the resolved main repo. <!--#6eadca0cd9497d94-->
  - `TestResumeRun.test_self_worktree_run_ignores_completed` (method) — Verifies a completed worktree engine.json at project_root falls through to a plain main-repo resume rather than self-resuming. <!--#c9562bf1cfaab090-->

## `tests/commands/merge/` — Test package for the `se3 merge` command, bundling unit and regression suites that harden every layer of the merge pipeline — CLI input validation and output bucketing, guardrail amend/reset rollback, conflict resolution, file locking, secret redaction, runtime sync, version aggregation/bumping, LLM tracing, and the failure-reason/result/post-condition data models. <!--#4b48ead055d24fb2|c46a3bc30c288bd3-->

### `tests/commands/merge/__init__.py` (python) — Empty package marker file that makes the merge command tests directory an importable Python package. <!--#e3b0c44298fc1c14|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_amend_reset_regression.py` (python) — A regression test suite for the merge guardrail-repair path, verifying safe amend/fix-up rollback (pre_amend_sha instead of HEAD~1, merge-commit assertions, ancestry post-conditions, silent_merge_loss detection), correct error propagation and None-vs-empty handling, injected shared LLMCaller, configurable max-iteration loading from se3.yaml, stall detection, and fail-closed timeout behavior. <!--#a969ffe30ee8ffb1|2ae231d6650524cb-->
- `_init_repo` (function) — Test helper that initializes a git repo with an initial commit and returns its SHA. <!--#391e1f1299f3c599-->
- `_create_branch` (function) — Test helper that creates a branch with given file content, commits it, returns its tip SHA, and switches back to master. <!--#16f64b077d444483-->
- `_make_violations` (function) — Test helper returning a sample list with one WEAKENING GuardrailViolation (SHALL→SHOULD) for a base spec file. <!--#4356bd681d0edde8-->
- `_make_original_specs` (function) — Test helper returning the original (pre-merge) spec contents mapping with the stricter SHALL wording. <!--#c8e35260df28a828-->
- `_make_merged_specs` (function) — Test helper returning the merged spec contents mapping with the weakened SHOULD wording. <!--#69602c6197c24744-->
- `_setup_spec_files` (function) — Test helper that writes a weakened (SHOULD) spec.md into the se3/specs/base directory under tmp_path. <!--#cffa6b8260eb27c7-->
- `TestPreAmendShaRollback` (class) — Test class verifying the amend repair path saves pre_amend_sha for rollback rather than resetting to HEAD~1. <!--#656adc7cacfb0547-->
  - `TestPreAmendShaRollback.test_amend_path_saves_pre_amend_sha` (method) — Test that when fix-up fails and amend is used but guardrails still fail, HEAD is rolled back to pre_amend_sha (not HEAD~1). <!--#13f58a56b8c8efac-->
  - `TestPreAmendShaRollback.test_fixup_commit_preferred_over_amend` (method) — Test that the fix-up commit path is tried first and, on success, leaves a new commit with the original merge commit still an ancestor. <!--#c5af1adc1cffb075-->
  - `TestPreAmendShaRollback.test_no_HEAD_tilde1_in_rollback` (method) — Test that scans the repair module source to ensure at most one executable use of 'reset --soft HEAD~1' (the safe fix-up path only). <!--#eb9208b6207d4b37-->
- `TestHeadIsMergeCommitAssertion` (class) — Test class verifying the amend path is rejected via a HEAD^2 check when HEAD is not a merge commit. <!--#b5014db94ec866aa-->
  - `TestHeadIsMergeCommitAssertion.test_amend_rejected_when_head_not_merge_commit` (method) — Test that repair fails with a 'HEAD is not a merge commit' error when amend is attempted on a regular (single-parent) commit. <!--#87079e7af112ad2a-->
- `TestRestoreMergedContent` (class) — Test class verifying _restore_merged_content re-raises write exceptions instead of swallowing them (A6). <!--#418c4d5005aaaca7-->
  - `TestRestoreMergedContent.test_restore_re_raises_on_write_failure` (method) — Test that _restore_merged_content propagates an OSError raised by a patched Path.write_text. <!--#58438c4e036b42ed-->
- `TestNoneVsEmptyComparisons` (class) — Test class verifying LLM raw_response and parsed results distinguish None from empty values with distinct errors (A7). <!--#f95c6076b1e50907-->
  - `TestNoneVsEmptyComparisons.test_raw_response_none_is_distinct_from_empty_string` (method) — Test that an LLM returning None produces a distinct 'returned None' error. <!--#a3c45cdfc00ff63e-->
  - `TestNoneVsEmptyComparisons.test_parsed_empty_dict_is_distinct_from_none` (method) — Test that an LLM returning an empty dict is caught early with a distinct 'empty response' error. <!--#2fa9038dc3c3f35c-->
- `TestAllowedPathsRefresh` (class) — Test class verifying allowed_paths is refreshed after a restore so out-of-spec writes are rejected (A8). <!--#194065c588b957e7-->
  - `TestAllowedPathsRefresh.test_allowed_paths_refreshed_after_restore` (method) — Test that a repair touching a file outside the spec dir fails with 'outside spec dir' and restores the valid file's merged content. <!--#a663ae903528f39f-->
- `TestPostConditionAfterRepair` (class) — Test class verifying repair success is tied to an ancestry post-condition check on the merge commit (A11). <!--#ae938e16cbb5a13c-->
  - `TestPostConditionAfterRepair.test_merge_lost_postcondition_fails` (method) — Test that repair succeeds when the merge commit is a real ancestor, then demonstrates the ancestry check would fail after resetting HEAD away from it. <!--#ef6e625c3fff0197-->
- `TestSharedLLMCaller` (class) — Test class verifying GuardrailRepairer accepts an injected shared LLMCaller and falls back when none is provided (A13). <!--#bc85dd54ca60de59-->
  - `TestSharedLLMCaller.test_llm_caller_injected` (method) — Test that a GuardrailRepairer constructed with an LLMCaller stores it on _llm_caller. <!--#b14e88a6ba4a645e-->
  - `TestSharedLLMCaller.test_llm_caller_none_uses_fallback` (method) — Test that passing llm_caller=None leaves _llm_caller as None for per-call fallback creation. <!--#6eb49994842c41a6-->
- `TestConfigurableMaxIterations` (class) — Test class verifying max repair iterations is read from se3.yaml with a default-of-2 fallback (Task 10 / A10). <!--#33db70be2374b14e-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_default_max_iterations` (method) — Test that _load_max_repair_iterations returns 2 when se3.yaml is absent. <!--#7df6c765c6fdf195-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_configurable_max_iterations` (method) — Test that _load_max_repair_iterations reads a configured value of 5 from se3.yaml. <!--#9eb6d209e0ba63bf-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_invalid_max_iterations_fallback` (method) — Test that a non-numeric max_iterations in se3.yaml falls back to the default of 2. <!--#f061a5e6b28566a7-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_zero_max_iterations_fallback` (method) — Test that a max_iterations of 0 in se3.yaml falls back to the default of 2. <!--#6632b47d1769a199-->
  - `TestConfigurableMaxIterations.test_orchestrator_honors_configured_max_iterations` (method) — Test that MergeOrchestrator stores the configured max_iterations (5) on its _max_repair_iterations attribute. <!--#44d3f9b892c3449d-->
- `TestStallDetection` (class) — Test class verifying last_hash stall detection avoids spurious matches on iteration 1 (A9). <!--#f87a83547844c02b-->
  - `TestStallDetection.test_stall_detected_at_iteration_1_with_none` (method) — Test that a None last_hash never registers a stall on the first iteration but matches on the second identical hash. <!--#dcb897f5b4415c9a-->
- `TestAsymmetricAllowFixupParent` (class) — Test class verifying that stray non-merge commits trip silent_merge_loss when allow_fixup_parent does not apply (no repair, or amend used). <!--#d6e9b6f820d9cd63-->
  - `TestAsymmetricAllowFixupParent.test_llm_resolved_stray_commit_trips_silent_merge_loss` (method) — Test that an LLM-resolved fast merge with no repair plus an injected stray commit fails the post-condition with silent_merge_loss. <!--#e1d7d288bbe852b4-->
  - `TestAsymmetricAllowFixupParent.test_amend_then_stray_commit_trips_silent_merge_loss` (method) — Test that when repair used amend (allow_fixup_parent=False), an injected stray commit fires silent_merge_loss since HEAD^1 is not checked. <!--#eb1caf663733c483-->
- `TestTimeoutFailClosed` (class) — Test class verifying a post-condition check timeout is treated as a fail-closed failure rather than a soft warning. <!--#e721ea57a3953dc6-->
  - `TestTimeoutFailClosed.test_postcond_check_timeout_returns_failure` (method) — Test that a TimeoutExpired from assert_branch_merged makes the orchestrator fail with postcond_check_timeout. <!--#18d6ec6efcb9cf8a-->
- `TestEmptyPostShaFallback` (class) — Test class verifying the repairer refuses success when post_sha is empty/unverifiable and the merge has actually been lost. <!--#3763497348e52fa1-->
  - `TestEmptyPostShaFallback.test_empty_post_sha_with_lost_merge_refuses_success` (method) — Test that empty post_sha plus a non-merge HEAD triggers the fallback check and refuses to declare repair success. <!--#ff43200a50d70e4b-->
  - `TestEmptyPostShaFallback.test_empty_post_sha_with_real_merge_succeeds` (method) — Test that empty post_sha still succeeds when HEAD is genuinely a merge commit and the branch is an ancestor, guarding against an over-zealous fallback. <!--#cb316f8073524fea-->
- `TestRollbackRefusesMissingPreRepairSha` (class) — Test class verifying that when pre_repair_sha cannot be captured, repair refuses to commit at all, leaving HEAD unchanged. <!--#783a154d77fac896-->
  - `TestRollbackRefusesMissingPreRepairSha.test_repair_refuses_to_commit_when_pre_repair_sha_unavailable` (method) — Test that with all rev-parse HEAD calls failing, repair returns failure without creating a fix-up commit and restores the merged working tree. <!--#6bc6df0b80e5fdbc-->
  - `TestRollbackRefusesMissingPreRepairSha.test_orchestrator_maps_inconsistent_state_to_failure_reason` (method) — Test that the orchestrator catches GuardrailRepairInconsistentState and pins the inconsistent_repair_state failure reason, hard-stopping the sequence. <!--#1742baba2943d87d-->
- `TestEndToEndAmendResetRegression` (class) — Test class providing end-to-end coverage of the A1-A4 incident via real MergeOrchestrator.execute runs plus typed-outcome population checks. <!--#a36133b695925f45-->
  - `TestEndToEndAmendResetRegression.test_full_merge_with_amend_keeps_branch_merged` (method) — Test that a real safe-strategy execute leaves the feature branch an ancestor of HEAD, satisfying assert_branch_merged. <!--#2399f02aecb6f2bb-->
  - `TestEndToEndAmendResetRegression.test_outcomes_populated_for_successful_merge` (method) — Test that a successful merge populates report.outcomes with one MergeOutcome carrying the merge commit SHA (G1[2]). <!--#6cc5d52f4cf8a952-->
  - `TestEndToEndAmendResetRegression.test_outcomes_populated_for_failed_merge` (method) — Test that a failed merge still produces a typed MergeOutcome with a FailureReason.MERGE_CONFLICT enum value (G1[2]). <!--#ae049a995280bc29-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_cli.py` (python) — Test suite for the `se3 merge` CLI hardening its input validation and output rendering — covering branch-name validation against flags, shell metacharacters, and git ref-format rules (I1/I2), fail-closed `_branch_exists` behavior when git is unavailable (I4), and the newly-merged vs already-ancestor bucket split in rendered output (I3) — exercised at the helper, programmatic `run_merge`, and end-to-end Typer CliRunner levels. <!--#68a320a45c1be9ee|91f8e1a0a955fe99-->
- `_init_repo` (function) — Test helper that initializes a git repo at a given path with user config and an initial committed README. <!--#ae786cd150546416-->
- `TestValidateBranchNames` (class) — Unit-test suite for the validate_branch_names helper covering empty lists, flag-like names, shell metacharacters, git ref-format rules, and pseudo-refs (defects I1/I2). <!--#3fb2f8d08d70b6b8-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_empty_list_raises` (method) — Asserts an empty branch list raises ValueError demanding at least one branch. <!--#15b508df42863c6a-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_empty_string_entry_rejected` (method) — Asserts an empty-string branch entry is rejected as non-empty. <!--#731e56d77eccc42a-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_leading_dash_rejected` (method) — Asserts a leading-dash name like '-rf' is rejected as a potential flag. <!--#20c6678eede3c537-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_double_dash_rejected` (method) — Asserts a double-dash name like '--force' is rejected as a flag. <!--#f7624ce99e185a97-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_shell_metachars_rejected` (method) — Parametrized test asserting branch names containing shell metacharacters or control characters are rejected. <!--#0e0204fb948d191b-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_git_ref_format_rules_rejected` (method) — Parametrized test asserting names violating git ref-format rules (e.g. '..', leading/trailing slash, '.lock', reflog syntax) are rejected. <!--#d610c956f05d4cb9-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_HEAD_rejected` (method) — Asserts the pseudo-ref 'HEAD' is rejected. <!--#c6ae23a881e92df9-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_at_sign_rejected` (method) — Asserts the pseudo-ref '@' is rejected. <!--#e4943f2bc0bf3387-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_valid_names_accepted` (method) — Asserts a set of legitimate branch names passes validation without raising. <!--#add788c436a91775-->
  - `TestValidateBranchNames.test_multi_invalid_names_listed` (method) — Asserts all invalid names in a mixed list appear in the error message so the operator can fix them at once. <!--#4aaff2d0797585f5-->
- `TestBranchExistsHardening` (class) — Test suite for defect I4 verifying _branch_exists honors returncode and fails closed on infrastructure failures (missing git, timeout). <!--#4a5316e516d6a11e-->
  - `TestBranchExistsHardening.test_existing_branch_returns_true` (method) — Asserts _branch_exists returns True for an existing branch. <!--#94be4fb26f4e9029-->
  - `TestBranchExistsHardening.test_missing_branch_returns_false` (method) — Asserts _branch_exists returns False for a non-existent branch by inspecting the show-ref returncode. <!--#9dbf2a3f21bf29f9-->
  - `TestBranchExistsHardening.test_missing_git_treated_as_missing_branch` (method) — Asserts that a FileNotFoundError from a missing git binary causes _branch_exists to fail closed and return False. <!--#adea515ffc7a6d3d-->
  - `TestBranchExistsHardening.test_timeout_treated_as_missing_branch` (method) — Asserts a subprocess timeout is caught and treated as a missing branch rather than propagating. <!--#0ff40f18fc62b57c-->
- `TestRunMergeRejectsBadInput` (class) — Test suite verifying programmatic run_merge validates input and returns exit code 1 on empty, flag-like, or metachar branch names. <!--#8539ec026e989c2f-->
  - `TestRunMergeRejectsBadInput.test_run_merge_rejects_empty_list` (method) — Asserts run_merge with an empty branch list returns exit code 1. <!--#d1c0242bdaf9049d-->
  - `TestRunMergeRejectsBadInput.test_run_merge_rejects_leading_dash` (method) — Asserts run_merge with a leading-dash branch name returns exit code 1. <!--#d9d4fb0700585113-->
  - `TestRunMergeRejectsBadInput.test_run_merge_rejects_metachar` (method) — Asserts run_merge with a metacharacter-containing branch name returns exit code 1. <!--#f283e4329b420d92-->
- `TestCliMergeBadInput` (class) — End-to-end Typer CliRunner test suite asserting bad merge input (empty, leading-dash, metachar) yields a non-zero exit code. <!--#ea533dd42db56d60-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput._invoke` (method) — Helper that initializes a repo, chdirs into it, and invokes the 'se3 merge' CLI via Typer's CliRunner, returning the result. <!--#32f32f18941cc0cb-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput.test_empty_branches_exits_nonzero` (method) — Asserts 'se3 merge' with no branch arguments exits non-zero. <!--#9654f2993b0bb83f-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput.test_leading_dash_branch_rejected` (method) — Asserts 'se3 merge -- -rf' exits non-zero and never reports the dash arg as a successfully merged branch. <!--#7950325b4baccede-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput.test_metachar_branch_rejected` (method) — Asserts 'se3 merge feat;ls' with a shell metachar exits non-zero. <!--#d505be1b357e8950-->
- `TestSplitMergedBuckets` (class) — Test suite for defect I3 verifying _split_merged_buckets partitions branches into newly-merged vs already-ancestor, including legacy fallback and git-ancestry fallback. <!--#2cffef0629f469e4-->
  - `TestSplitMergedBuckets.test_split_with_typed_buckets` (method) — Asserts the splitter passes through the report's typed newly-merged and already-ancestor buckets unchanged. <!--#69ec584e52afe9ec-->
  - `TestSplitMergedBuckets.test_split_falls_back_to_legacy_aggregate` (method) — Asserts that when typed buckets are empty, the legacy aggregate list is treated as all newly-merged. <!--#80e9b683e5bf6c1e-->
  - `TestSplitMergedBuckets.test_split_empty_when_nothing_merged` (method) — Asserts the splitter returns two empty lists when nothing was merged. <!--#6a284812ce4f8f6b-->
  - `TestSplitMergedBuckets.test_fallback_uses_git_ancestry_when_project_root_provided` (method) — Asserts that with a project_root, the legacy fallback uses real git ancestry to classify branches as already-ancestor vs newly-merged. <!--#1d95c8163dd1e09e-->
- `TestCliRendersBucketSplit` (class) — Test suite for defect I3 verifying run_merge's rendered output cleanly separates newly-merged and already-ancestor sections. <!--#70cb3407db4cf87d-->
  - `TestCliRendersBucketSplit.test_success_renders_only_newly_merged_section` (method) — Asserts that when all branches produced new commits, only the newly-merged section is rendered. <!--#44a84d27d20dbe60-->
  - `TestCliRendersBucketSplit.test_success_renders_only_already_ancestor_section` (method) — Asserts that when all branches were already ancestors, only the already-ancestor section is rendered. <!--#1a51810ad06f9750-->
  - `TestCliRendersBucketSplit.test_success_renders_both_sections_disjoint` (method) — Asserts the user's mixed scenario renders both sections in order with each branch under the correct heading and a total summary line. <!--#044084fea3d12f31-->
- `TestCliMergeBadInput` (class) — End-to-end Typer CliRunner test suite asserting bad merge input (empty, leading-dash, metachar) yields a non-zero exit code. <!--#ea533dd42db56d60-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput._invoke` (method) — Helper that initializes a repo, chdirs into it, and invokes the 'se3 merge' CLI via Typer's CliRunner, returning the result. <!--#32f32f18941cc0cb-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput.test_empty_branches_exits_nonzero` (method) — Asserts 'se3 merge' with no branch arguments exits non-zero. <!--#9654f2993b0bb83f-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput.test_leading_dash_branch_rejected` (method) — Asserts 'se3 merge -- -rf' exits non-zero and never reports the dash arg as a successfully merged branch. <!--#7950325b4baccede-->
  - `TestCliMergeBadInput.test_metachar_branch_rejected` (method) — Asserts 'se3 merge feat;ls' with a shell metachar exits non-zero. <!--#d505be1b357e8950-->
- `TestRunMergeEndToEndAcceptance` (class) — End-to-end acceptance suite asserting a successful run_merge produces a real merge commit (parent_count>=2), reachable branch, and an advanced version file to catch silent merge loss. <!--#c6bacd18df9ec201-->
  - `TestRunMergeEndToEndAcceptance._init_versioned_repo` (method) — Helper that initializes a git repo with pyproject.toml at version 1.0.0 and gitignore, returning the default branch name. <!--#d7562a4ec913a33a-->
  - `TestRunMergeEndToEndAcceptance._git` (method) — Helper that runs a git command in the given repo path and returns the completed process. <!--#b25538f273fe5ffa-->
  - `TestRunMergeEndToEndAcceptance.test_e2e_merge_advances_head_and_version` (method) — End-to-end test asserting a clean feature-branch merge advances HEAD with a true merge commit, makes the branch reachable, and bumps pyproject.toml's version. <!--#4aa2fdcc567d9429-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_conflict_resolver.py` (python) — Pytest suite hardening the merge ConflictResolver/ConflictContext (cases D1–D9), covering HunkResolution line-number validation, the resolved-content byte cap, whitespace-tolerant conflict-marker detection, SHA resolution that raises on bad refs, and binary/encoding classification by magic bytes and gitattributes. <!--#ce9941d5a55d1270|5fb18c637c90af93-->
- `TestHunkResolutionValidation` (class) — D1 test class verifying HunkResolution rejects malformed start/end line numbers (negative, zero, huge, non-int, float, bool, None, end-before-start) while accepting valid and digit-string inputs. <!--#d42ae0584b6b38ef-->
  - `TestHunkResolutionValidation.test_basic_valid_hunk` (method) — Asserts a HunkResolution with valid start/end lines stores them unchanged. <!--#1192ba2e85f35d10-->
  - `TestHunkResolutionValidation.test_equal_start_and_end` (method) — Asserts a single-line hunk (start == end) is accepted. <!--#ccd80915531ac60a-->
  - `TestHunkResolutionValidation.test_negative_start_line_raises` (method) — Asserts a negative start_line raises HunkValidationError requiring >= 1. <!--#0758e3c3d58d231b-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_failure_reason.py` (python) — Unit tests for the FailureReason enum, covering its numeric grouping values, IntEnum ordering/equality, and bidirectional conversion to/from legacy strings including compound and unknown-string handling. <!--#0bcdb96f14d9b575|0758a3b81145e08b-->

  - `TestFailureReasonValues.test_guardrail_violation` (method) — Asserts FailureReason.GUARDRAIL_VIOLATION equals 500. <!--#266c0611cf938886-->
  - `TestFailureReasonValues.test_rollback_failed` (method) — Asserts FailureReason.ROLLBACK_FAILED equals 600. <!--#2e64a6ecb3ab9bbb-->
  - `TestFailureReasonValues.test_runtime_sync_collision` (method) — Asserts FailureReason.RUNTIME_SYNC_COLLISION equals 800. <!--#67d983fc5d4558c3-->
  - `TestFailureReasonValues.test_postcond_branch_not_merged` (method) — Asserts FailureReason.POSTCOND_BRANCH_NOT_MERGED equals 900. <!--#bb001a9ef953df0a-->
  - `TestFailureReasonValues.test_lock_busy` (method) — Asserts FailureReason.LOCK_BUSY equals 990. <!--#af6ba7d75f035207-->
  - `TestFailureReasonValues.test_unexpected` (method) — Asserts the catch-all FailureReason.UNEXPECTED equals 9999. <!--#4e8f278db179fabd-->
- `TestLegacyString` (class) — Test class covering conversion between FailureReason enum members and their legacy string representations in both directions. <!--#3ce8f397f536a350-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_legacy_string_property` (method) — Checks the legacy_string property returns the expected snake_case name for several members. <!--#44789381557679b5-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_exact_match` (method) — Verifies an exact legacy string parses to its member with no detail. <!--#90543e85c97a12db-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_none` (method) — Verifies a None input parses to (None, None). <!--#5db88e68f8f3e2b2-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_empty` (method) — Verifies an empty string parses to FailureReason.NONE with no detail. <!--#c2e19c31d805f517-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_whitespace` (method) — Verifies a whitespace-only string parses to FailureReason.NONE with no detail. <!--#01c1a35a1a3fbe4a-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_unknown` (method) — Verifies an unrecognized string parses to UNEXPECTED, preserving the original text as detail. <!--#d3484a7856f703fb-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_compound_fast_abort` (method) — Verifies a 'fast_abort: ...' compound string splits into the FAST_ABORT member and a detail string. <!--#7f34ad80814834d5-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_compound_fast_failure` (method) — Verifies a 'fast_failure: ...' compound string splits into the FAST_FAILURE member and a detail string. <!--#6fb0c72aabb5129c-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_compound_merge_failed` (method) — Verifies a 'merge_failed: ...' compound string splits into the MERGE_FAILED member and a detail string. <!--#8ec329e4fedc00e5-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_from_legacy_string_bare_prefix_no_separator` (method) — Verifies a prefix without a ': ' separator (e.g. 'fast_abort_extra') does NOT match and falls through to UNEXPECTED. <!--#5c5c8e65ede4f5de-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_to_legacy_string_none` (method) — Verifies to_legacy_string(None) returns None. <!--#57b88ab720633b2b-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_to_legacy_string_none_reason` (method) — Verifies to_legacy_string(FailureReason.NONE) returns the empty string. <!--#fddc2e9b7623d9ef-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_to_legacy_string_normal` (method) — Verifies to_legacy_string returns the expected legacy string for a normal member. <!--#b8154ca2a8d3c540-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_round_trip_all_members` (method) — Verifies every member except UNEXPECTED round-trips exactly through to_legacy_string and from_legacy_string. <!--#7c57328c3f49b608-->
  - `TestLegacyString.test_every_member_has_legacy_map_entry` (method) — Guards against drift by asserting each member's legacy_string is a key in _LEGACY_STRING_MAP that resolves back to the same member. <!--#d634feea1457fe74-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_llm_trace.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the LLMTrace component, covering its start/stop lifecycle and context-manager protocol, JSONL record writing (sequencing, previews, truncation, auto-start), size-based file rotation with unique filenames, and LLMCallRecord dataclass serialization. <!--#48a7e3930473cf22|f80a066a266f67fb-->
- `tmp_project` (function) — Pytest fixture returning a temporary directory path used as the project root for each LLMTrace test. <!--#148d54b377839e21-->
- `TestLLMTraceLifecycle` (class) — Test class verifying LLMTrace start/stop behavior and its context-manager protocol. <!--#7ee74ab2c11bcd3b-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_start_creates_file` (method) — Asserts that calling start() creates the current trace file on disk. <!--#ade501c12d1ce6d3-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_context_manager` (method) — Asserts that using LLMTrace as a context manager sets started/file on entry and clears started on exit. <!--#a8ecafb1955bdac6-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_stop_closes_file` (method) — Asserts that stop() closes and clears the underlying file handle. <!--#ccae2c1c2811ba8a-->
  - `TestLLMTraceLifecycle.test_idempotent_start` (method) — Asserts that a second start() call is a no-op leaving the current path unchanged. <!--#f0af30f54d12f869-->
- `TestLLMTraceRecord` (class) — Test class verifying record() writes correct JSONL output, sequence numbering, previews, and auto-start. <!--#fabad25326ed3477-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_seq_monotonic` (method) — Asserts that successive record() calls return monotonically increasing sequence numbers starting at 1. <!--#c59b5bb482d7718a-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_record_content` (method) — Asserts a recorded entry serializes all fields (agent, previews, duration, outcome, meta, seq, timestamp) correctly to JSONL. <!--#b115470033f7a923-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_preview_truncation` (method) — Asserts that a long prompt is truncated to the configured preview_chars length in the written record. <!--#e0c58e4528b58d34-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_empty_prompt_and_response` (method) — Asserts that omitting prompt/response yields empty-string preview fields. <!--#004463f8fcbee644-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRecord.test_auto_start_on_record` (method) — Asserts that calling record() without an explicit start() auto-starts the trace. <!--#2fc8e3ca505c85b1-->
- `TestLLMTraceRotation` (class) — Test class verifying log file rotation when the configured size limit is reached. <!--#641ffb6f434260d7-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRotation.test_rotation` (method) — Asserts that exceeding max_file_bytes rotates to a new file while preserving the first file and its record. <!--#a134b69c22057c63-->
  - `TestLLMTraceRotation.test_rotation_filenames_unique_in_same_microsecond` (method) — Regression test freezing the clock to force multiple rotations and verify rotated filenames remain unique. <!--#1e8627d5de225ba4-->
- `TestLLMCallRecord` (class) — Test class verifying LLMCallRecord dataclass serialization. <!--#4dfb415b3d1003d8-->
  - `TestLLMCallRecord.test_to_dict` (method) — Asserts that LLMCallRecord.to_dict() emits the expected key/value fields. <!--#78d9689cb6100eea-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_merge_lock.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the fcntl-based `MergeLock`, exercising its acquire/release lifecycle, contention with busy errors, stale (dead-PID) detection and breaking, blocking/queueing acquisition, and genuine cross-process exclusivity. <!--#459a7fbb27fb98eb|723715331b9dbd01-->
- `tmp_project` (function) — Pytest fixture returning a temporary project root with the `se3/state/` directory pre-created for lock-file placement. <!--#beca064ed79eb2ad-->
- `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease` (class) — Test class covering the basic acquire/release lifecycle, context-manager use, PID recording, and idempotent re-acquire. <!--#18faf1f8a6d59f63-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_acquire_creates_lock_file` (method) — Asserts that acquiring the lock creates the resolved lock file on disk. <!--#6ca01a9ff773d7cc-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_release_removes_fd` (method) — Asserts that releasing the lock clears the held file descriptor back to None. <!--#71a776b3137df160-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_context_manager` (method) — Verifies the lock works as a context manager, holding the fd inside the `with` block and releasing on exit. <!--#695257470f18115f-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_lock_file_contains_pid` (method) — Verifies the lock file's contents record the holding process's PID. <!--#7ebf49980dbaa1a1-->
  - `TestMergeLockAcquireRelease.test_idempotent_start` (method) — Verifies a second acquire on an already-held lock is a no-op rather than an error. <!--#b5bdde0487673e57-->
- `TestMergeLockContention` (class) — Test class covering two lock instances competing for the same lock and the busy-error behavior. <!--#51fb302227f092c8-->
  - `TestMergeLockContention.test_second_acquire_raises_busy` (method) — Asserts a second acquire while one is held raises MergeLockBusy. <!--#be8f6f881202ac48-->
  - `TestMergeLockContention.test_second_acquire_sees_holder_pid` (method) — Asserts the MergeLockBusy exception exposes the current holder's PID. <!--#c2464523a2846cda-->
  - `TestMergeLockContention.test_factory_function` (method) — Verifies the `acquire_merge_lock` factory returns an already-acquired lock. <!--#60272630d1b5c0e4-->
- `TestMergeLockStale` (class) — Test class covering stale-lock (dead-PID) detection and optional break-and-reacquire behavior. <!--#22e491783b69242c-->
  - `TestMergeLockStale.test_stale_lock_raises_stale` (method) — Asserts acquiring over a lock file holding a nonexistent PID raises MergeLockStale carrying that PID. <!--#8395e96978126683-->
  - `TestMergeLockStale.test_break_stale_removes_and_reacquires` (method) — Asserts `acquire(break_stale=True)` clears a stale lock and reacquires it, recording the caller's PID. <!--#01f333dad2a81622-->
  - `TestMergeLockStale.test_unparseable_pid_raises_stale_with_none` (method) — Asserts that when a held lock file has an unparseable PID, MergeLockStale carries holder_pid=None and an 'unparseable' message. <!--#93969f06beece540-->
- `TestMergeLockBlocking` (class) — Test class covering blocking (queueing) acquisition semantics where `acquire(blocking=True)` waits for the holder instead of failing fast. <!--#ce8061cae0cff76e-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_acquire_waits_for_release` (method) — Verifies a blocking acquire waits until a background thread releases the lock, then records the caller's PID. <!--#fa5bf0422f2cd38e-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_context_manager_default` (method) — Verifies constructing `MergeLock(root, blocking=True)` seeds blocking mode for context-manager acquire. <!--#156e03b82948bd73-->
  - `TestMergeLockBlocking.test_blocking_acquire_over_unheld_stale_file` (method) — Verifies a blocking acquire over an unheld stale lock file is granted immediately rather than wedging. <!--#3037ae24a903c952-->

### `tests/commands/merge/test_runtime_sync.py` (python) — Regression test suite for the runtime_sync merge hardening (Group G6, defects E1–E5), exercising symlink-destination rejection, lenient-vs-strict failure preservation, sidecar self-collision filtering, bounded chunked I/O caps, and end-to-end sync idempotency. <!--#a5a653a5851d5b4f|04b4047a774a4cd0-->
- `_make_sync_call` (function) — Test helper that returns a callable invoking sync_branch_runtime with the per-branch worktree lookup stubbed to a fixed source directory. <!--#e2f317124895190d-->
- `TestSymlinkDestinationRejected` (class) — Test class verifying _atomic_write_bytes refuses symlinked destinations (O_NOFOLLOW guard) to block path-takeover/TOCTOU attacks while still allowing normal writes. <!--#e4483b2104f727ee-->
  - `TestSymlinkDestinationRejected.test_planted_symlink_to_external_file_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts a symlink at the destination pointing to an external file causes ELOOP and leaves the external file untouched. <!--#18e14d502404429b-->
  - `TestSymlinkDestinationRejected.test_planted_symlink_to_inside_target_tree_is_rejected` (method) — Asserts even an in-tree symlink destination is uniformly rejected with ELOOP and its target file is left unchanged. <!--#cb791fbdd3ddec7a-->
  - `TestSymlinkDestinationRejected.test_normal_write_still_works` (method) — Regression check that the symlink guard does not break a normal write to a fresh destination. <!--#372990f2b5d8bcbe-->
  - `TestSymlinkDestinationRejected.test_write_overwrite_regular_file_still_works` (method) — Regression check that the symlink guard still permits overwriting an existing regular file. <!--#5b2f690e4f021265-->
  - `TestSymlinkDestinationRejected.test_toctou_post_write_recheck_catches_late_symlink_swap` (method) — Simulates a symlink planted mid-write and asserts the post-write recheck still rejects it with ELOOP, protecting the external file. <!--#c2b78c0c5a281a09-->
- `TestLenientModePreservesSuccess` (class) — Test class verifying that when an unexpected exception escapes per-file handlers, lenient mode preserves already-succeeded work while strict mode still rolls everything back. <!--#f2d7c1598b401941-->
  - `TestLenientModePreservesSuccess.test_already_copied_files_preserved_on_unexpected_failure` (method) — Asserts that in lenient mode a successfully copied file survives a later propagated exception that fires the outer except net. <!--#0bb96c45e49d60c7-->
  - `TestLenientModePreservesSuccess.test_strict_mode_still_rolls_back` (method) — Asserts strict mode keeps its all-or-nothing promise by rolling back the copied file and the se3/ root on a propagated failure. <!--#bb383c7344d6d7d2-->
  - `TestLenientModePreservesSuccess.test_lenient_mode_preserves_already_written_sidecars` (method) — Asserts a sidecar written before an uncaught RuntimeError remains on disk in lenient mode. <!--#fee761d935614a70-->
- `TestSidecarSelfCollisionFiltered` (class) — Test class verifying source-side sidecar-named files are filtered at collection time so repeated syncs stay idempotent without accumulating .from-A.from-B chains. <!--#0e615694b772b8df-->
  - `TestSidecarSelfCollisionFiltered.test_is_sidecar_filename_pattern` (method) — Unit-tests the _is_sidecar_filename regex against positive sidecar shapes (plain, hash-disambiguated, safe-label) and negative non-sidecar names. <!--#1174d91c8a23f631-->
  - `TestSidecarSelfCollisionFiltered.test_source_sidecar_files_are_filtered` (method) — Asserts leftover sidecar files in the source worktree are neither copied nor recorded as skipped, never reaching the destination. <!--#df64f32db9a613a0-->
  - `TestSidecarSelfCollisionFiltered.test_repeated_sync_is_idempotent_no_chain_accumulation` (method) — Asserts running sync three times yields exactly one sidecar with no nested .from-feature.from- chains. <!--#09b64566c9375805-->
  - `TestSidecarSelfCollisionFiltered.test_sidecar_glob_pattern_files_skipped` (method) — Asserts sidecar leftovers under glob-pattern paths (e.g. state/summary-*) are also filtered out. <!--#1995d8aa89b2aca0-->
- `TestBoundedReadAndWrite` (class) — Test class verifying the chunked read/write loops enforce iteration, byte-size, and duration caps so hostile or malformed files cannot hang the merge. <!--#77aaa6c8c16a7675-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_read_byte_cap` (method) — Asserts _bounded_read_chunks raises OSError(EFBIG) once the total-byte cap is exceeded. <!--#6a7baa01c6db66ab-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_read_iteration_cap` (method) — Asserts the read iteration cap raises EFBIG independently of total bytes read. <!--#ee5b76d24688595d-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_read_duration_cap` (method) — Asserts an exceeded read duration deadline raises OSError(ETIMEDOUT). <!--#04a3cc10e9ea7124-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_read_returns_full_content_within_caps` (method) — Regression check that bounded reads return the full file content when within all caps. <!--#610f47729155ee41-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_write_zero_progress_raises` (method) — Asserts a no-progress os.write (returns 0) raises OSError(EIO) on a single attempt rather than spinning forever. <!--#e9f38eaf63b81e40-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_write_duration_cap` (method) — Asserts _bounded_write_all honors the time deadline by raising ETIMEDOUT. <!--#cdb80a3f318f9b88-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_bounded_write_empty_content_no_op` (method) — Asserts writing empty content is a no-op that returns immediately without touching the fd. <!--#6d59a9ff7ffba05f-->
  - `TestBoundedReadAndWrite.test_symlink_loop_bounded_via_read_caps` (method) — Asserts an oversized source file is skipped (lenient mode absorbs the OSError) so the merge completes without hanging. <!--#380deceb655fb6e7-->
- `TestIdempotentEndToEnd` (class) — Test class with end-to-end sanity checks that the four hardening fixes compose so repeated syncs remain idempotent. <!--#76d8ec44d199c97b-->
  - `TestIdempotentEndToEnd.test_repeated_clean_sync_is_no_op` (method) — Asserts a second sync of identical content is an idempotent skip with no copy, collision, or sidecar. <!--#b1c3dd8fcefd7d67-->
  - `TestIdempotentEndToEnd.test_repeated_collision_sync_idempotent` (method) — Asserts a conflicting-content sync creates one sidecar initially, then registers idempotent bypasses on repeat runs with no chain or hash-suffix accumulation. <!--#a2895185720373bd-->

## `tests/core/` — Unit test suite for core utility helpers, currently covering the truncate_preview string-shortening function across normal, custom-parameter, unicode, multiline, and edge cases. <!--#c56348f261104338|a803a15a966939d0-->

### `tests/core/__init__.py` (python) — Package initializer marking the test directory for core utility unit tests. <!--#ac166613d2af2787|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/core/test_utils.py` (python) — Unit test module whose TestTruncatePreview class exercises the truncate_preview helper across normal, custom-parameter, unicode, multiline, and edge cases to verify it shortens strings to a max length with a configurable ellipsis. <!--#dbba325123f257ec|ac06f7bbf86b6eb6-->
- `TestTruncatePreview` (class) — Test class grouping all cases that verify truncate_preview correctly shortens strings with an ellipsis under various length and parameter conditions. <!--#571f10d0603d279e-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_empty_string_returns_empty` (method) — Asserts that passing an empty string returns an empty string. <!--#b15a98eac9df3ffb-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_shorter_than_limit_returns_unchanged` (method) — Verifies a string shorter than max_length is returned as the same unchanged object. <!--#7c6c7ebe7f3ceaa5-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_exact_length_returns_unchanged` (method) — Verifies a string exactly at the length limit is returned unchanged and uncopied. <!--#2604b68abae5e47d-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_exceeding_limit_truncates_with_ellipsis` (method) — Checks that an over-length string is truncated and suffixed with an ellipsis to exactly max_length. <!--#329ec84906f2f85a-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_unicode_characters_handled_correctly` (method) — Ensures CJK and emoji characters are each counted as one when truncating. <!--#f412c9818111c458-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_custom_max_length_parameter` (method) — Confirms a custom max_length value produces the expected truncated output length. <!--#19a6bd6fe9c9ff9c-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_custom_ellipsis_string` (method) — Confirms a custom ellipsis string is appended in place of the default '...'. <!--#18100df0e1ecfa5e-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_ellipsis_longer_than_max_length` (method) — Edge case verifying the ellipsis itself is truncated when longer than max_length. <!--#9d20b7ca57d104a0-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_max_length_equals_ellipsis_length` (method) — Edge case where max_length equals the ellipsis length, returning just the ellipsis. <!--#b67ddc3e0e43333d-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_single_character_max_length` (method) — Edge case verifying a max_length of 1 returns a single character. <!--#b381c3f0c86af42a-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_newlines_in_text` (method) — Verifies multi-line text is truncated correctly to the exact length with ellipsis. <!--#653d67df336bff9a-->
  - `TestTruncatePreview.test_default_max_length_is_100` (method) — Confirms the default max_length is 100, truncating to 97 chars plus an ellipsis. <!--#4f1b399a237cf8f6-->

### `tests/engine/test_baseline_fix_loop.py` (python) — Test suite for mechanism B — the bounded, budget-limited looping of inherited (baseline) test failures in test_handler — covering within-budget looping, disabled/exhausted budgets, cross-flow given-up exclusion, and mixed introduced/baseline failure handling. <!--#bb56599ad0bb705b|eb48e3bcadffb717-->

### `tests/engine/test_baseline_module.py` (python) — Unit tests for the baseline test-run module, covering git-derived baseline-key computation, the bounded/atomic on-disk failure cache, the BaselineCapture launch/wait/kill lifecycle with failure-ID parsing and recursion guards, and resolution of the configurable baseline timeout. <!--#4c129004d2fa6fbd|b3659dca0fbfbf30-->
- `_git` (function) — Helper that runs a git subcommand in a given directory, raising on non-zero exit. <!--#4d03c5ca196c4c7c-->
- `git_repo` (function) — Pytest fixture providing a freshly initialized git repository with one committed file. <!--#3595cbba9e350caa-->
- `_py_print_command` (function) — Helper that builds a `python -c` command which prints a given body and exits zero. <!--#fdcbb03109808f97-->
- `TestComputeBaselineKey` (class) — Tests that compute_baseline_key is stable for an unchanged tree but changes on HEAD, tracked, or untracked content edits. <!--#3e2c1742c13ca0fd-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_stable_for_unchanged_tree` (method) — Asserts the baseline key is identical across calls on an unchanged tree and has the head:dirty form. <!--#35ff829c306de2bf-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_changes_on_head_change` (method) — Asserts the baseline key changes after a new commit moves HEAD. <!--#c338ec26a40a95af-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_changes_on_tracked_modification` (method) — Asserts the baseline key changes when a tracked file is modified without committing. <!--#60418cd7cfa2e500-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_changes_on_untracked_content` (method) — Asserts adding and then editing untracked file content each shift the baseline key. <!--#e546805d74335034-->
  - `TestComputeBaselineKey.test_non_git_dir_does_not_raise` (method) — Asserts a non-git directory yields a string key prefixed with 'no-head:' rather than raising. <!--#49ba46bb2ad9da63-->
- `TestBaselineCache` (class) — Tests the on-disk baseline cache: round-trip, hit/miss semantics, corruption tolerance, bounding, and atomic writes. <!--#f26adb14f46c5b49-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_round_trip_hit` (method) — Asserts a saved failure set is read back identically for the same key. <!--#5997ca605e765382-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_empty_set_is_a_hit_not_a_miss` (method) — Asserts a cached empty set loads as an empty set (a hit), distinct from a None miss. <!--#0afae4918df906a4-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_missing_file_is_miss` (method) — Asserts loading from a nonexistent cache file returns None. <!--#35ac32b6958f0d56-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_unknown_key_is_miss` (method) — Asserts loading an unsaved key returns None even when other keys exist. <!--#9af4e2169e08410e-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_corrupt_json_is_miss` (method) — Asserts a cache file with invalid JSON is treated as a miss (returns None). <!--#9c39405c78fbf2f9-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_schema_mismatch_is_miss` (method) — Asserts a cache file with an unrecognized schema_version is treated as a miss. <!--#481b991450893f86-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_save_preserves_other_keys` (method) — Asserts saving one key does not overwrite previously saved keys. <!--#44354eeb93b3b5a5-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_cache_is_bounded` (method) — Asserts the cache evicts oldest entries once MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES is exceeded. <!--#ef7189669d7f2b95-->
  - `TestBaselineCache.test_atomic_write_leaves_no_tmp` (method) — Asserts the atomic save leaves no leftover temporary files behind. <!--#229289b723094e42-->
- `TestBaselineCapture` (class) — Tests BaselineCapture's launch/wait lifecycle, failure-ID parsing, recursion-guard env, idempotency, and the None infra-failure sentinel. <!--#0258b1770d194d78-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_parses_failed_ids` (method) — Asserts capture parses out the set of FAILED test IDs from subprocess output. <!--#c99d72414043f287-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_all_passed_returns_empty_set` (method) — Asserts an all-passing run resolves to an empty set rather than None. <!--#eaa31b2711465301-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_wait_blocks_until_ready` (method) — Asserts is_ready is False right after launch and wait() blocks until the slow run completes. <!--#8416f225cb9b92c0-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_infra_failure_returns_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts a non-zero exit with no parseable per-test output resolves to the None sentinel. <!--#c3c02e5b0555b59b-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_launch_failure_returns_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts a failure to launch the command is immediately ready and resolves to None. <!--#4b3a1f5099033cec-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_sets_recursion_guard_env` (method) — Asserts the child subprocess sees SE3_TEST_RUNNING=1 to guard against recursive test runs. <!--#a5d52ace5e789446-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_wait_is_idempotent` (method) — Asserts repeated wait() calls return the same resolved result. <!--#2e3d29481ca17e0f-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_wait_timeout_raises_then_resolves` (method) — Asserts wait() with a short timeout raises TimeoutExpired but remains resumable to completion. <!--#2def5cf22cb7963b-->
  - `TestBaselineCapture.test_resolve_command_defaults_to_pytest_verbose` (method) — Asserts the default resolved command runs pytest in verbose (-v) mode. <!--#59b8e7921a4687bb-->
- `TestBaselineTimeoutKill` (class) — Tests BaselineCapture.wait_or_kill/kill behavior: timeout-kills the subprocess, returns None, sets timed_out, and is idempotent. <!--#370ef7ae91c50b96-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_returns_none_and_kills_on_timeout` (method) — Asserts wait_or_kill on timeout returns None, sets timed_out, and actually terminates the subprocess. <!--#bbb42dda51601768-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_resolves_normally_within_bound` (method) — Asserts wait_or_kill returns the parsed failures and leaves timed_out False when the run finishes in time. <!--#f056cbb5fdf103b4-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_none_timeout_is_unbounded` (method) — Asserts wait_or_kill with timeout=None waits indefinitely and resolves normally. <!--#ec11ed9b2827e801-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_kill_is_idempotent` (method) — Asserts calling kill twice does not raise and keeps the resolved None sentinel. <!--#3d175b8284bef17f-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_kill_before_resolution_yields_none_sentinel` (method) — Asserts killing before resolution makes a subsequent wait_or_kill return None. <!--#b8103279018cca75-->
  - `TestBaselineTimeoutKill.test_wait_or_kill_after_done_returns_cached` (method) — Asserts a bounded wait_or_kill after the run already resolved returns the cached result. <!--#677079820c630792-->
- `TestResolveBaselineTimeout` (class) — Tests resolve_baseline_timeout's default and se3.yaml-configured timeout values. <!--#5b51d0e4a641a5db-->
  - `TestResolveBaselineTimeout.test_defaults_when_not_a_project` (method) — Asserts the default baseline timeout is 1800 seconds when no se3.yaml is present. <!--#f124d3520a45e0e3-->
  - `TestResolveBaselineTimeout.test_reads_configured_timeout` (method) — Asserts a configured test.timeout in se3.yaml is read as the baseline timeout. <!--#f71b09b142a8b9f8-->

### `tests/engine/test_chat_history.py` (python) — Pytest suite for the chat_history module covering format_history_for_retry (continue vs retry modes, prompt/response truncation rules, empty-history handling) and record_user_interjection (JSONL output shape, append safety, no-op guards, and exclusion of interjections from retry context while keeping them visible in step history). <!--#1f0894cb44ac9187|d800b9196812e12d-->

  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_retry_mode_uses_restart_instruction` (method) — Asserts retry mode emits the try-again restart instruction and omits the continue wording. <!--#18c9039d0f3443c5-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_continue_mode_user_prompt_not_truncated` (method) — Asserts continue mode preserves a long user prompt verbatim without truncation. <!--#ea702d978ab5290e-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_retry_mode_user_prompt_not_truncated` (method) — Asserts retry mode preserves a long user prompt verbatim without truncation. <!--#4797e01033972d64-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_continue_mode_preserves_tool_call_responses` (method) — Asserts continue mode keeps tool-call content and results intact rather than truncating them. <!--#5eabb3548cd0b449-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_retry_mode_truncates_long_assistant_responses` (method) — Asserts retry mode applies head+tail truncation (head 500, tail 1500) to long assistant responses. <!--#3890950494841c58-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_no_history_returns_none` (method) — Asserts format_history_for_retry returns None when no session history exists. <!--#dd1e9b42d61fb15a-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_empty_messages_returns_none` (method) — Asserts format_history_for_retry returns None when the session has no messages. <!--#0882b40bd2343266-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_continue_mode_short_prompts_not_truncated` (method) — Asserts short prompts pass through untruncated in continue mode. <!--#d5fa191a858be6af-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_user_prompt_preserved_verbatim_regardless_of_size` (method) — Asserts the old 50K per-prompt cap is gone so even a 60K-char user prompt is preserved verbatim. <!--#a7b6069de9bed331-->
  - `TestFormatHistoryForRetryMode.test_user_prompt_at_50k_not_truncated` (method) — Regression guard asserting a prompt exactly 50K chars passes through unchanged. <!--#4e8de450ce10ef27-->
- `TestRecordUserInterjection` (class) — Test class for record_user_interjection covering JSONL output shape, append safety, missing-id no-ops, and visibility via get_step_history. <!--#438d1d8e578f7efe-->
  - `TestRecordUserInterjection.test_writes_one_jsonl_line_with_expected_shape` (method) — Asserts a single interjection writes one JSONL line at the expected path with all expected fields. <!--#a625079813841ffb-->
  - `TestRecordUserInterjection.test_concurrent_appends_preserve_line_boundaries` (method) — Asserts repeated calls each append exactly one parseable whole line with no interleaving. <!--#66740b30c701c499-->
  - `TestRecordUserInterjection.test_missing_flow_id_is_noop` (method) — Asserts an empty flow_id logs a warning and writes nothing rather than raising. <!--#d95baf3cf7d2a7c9-->
