### `tests/engine/test_chat_history_fix_loop_split.py` (python) — Unit tests for chat_history's fix-loop helpers — split_implement_session_by_iterations (partitioning an implement ChatSession into per-iteration virtual sessions using test-session timestamps as fences) and interleave_sessions_for_display (reordering a flow's sessions so implement iterations appear chronologically between their test/self_check rounds) — exercising multi-round, single-round, empty, unsorted, and missing-fence edge cases using in-memory fixtures. <!--#3d1c52c34c92423e|8eea953b60d7b2d7-->
- `_msg` (function) — Test helper that builds a minimal ChatMessage with a given timestamp (and optional content/role) for use in fixtures. <!--#16a73ea2e20473ab-->
- `_session` (function) — Test helper that constructs a ChatSession with the given step id/type and one message per supplied timestamp. <!--#c1c47d0718329060-->
- `test_split_multi_round_returns_n_virtual_sessions` (function) — Asserts that splitting a multi-round implement session on test fences yields N suffixed -iterK virtual sessions with the expected per-bucket message counts and preserved metadata. <!--#fe3d1a397736cd01-->
- `test_split_single_round_returns_original_session` (function) — Asserts that when all implement messages precede the only test fence, the split returns the original session unchanged. <!--#7a875561a8cbc3aa-->
- `test_split_empty_session_returns_empty_list` (function) — Asserts that splitting an implement session with no messages yields an empty list regardless of fences. <!--#409f62983f20756a-->
- `test_split_without_any_test_fences_returns_original` (function) — Asserts that splitting with no test fences returns the original session unchanged. <!--#1c3214d25a0233de-->
- `test_split_preserves_message_order_within_bucket` (function) — Asserts that messages retain their original chronological order within each split bucket. <!--#e2d1a827793d9b90-->
- `test_split_handles_unsorted_test_timestamps` (function) — Asserts that out-of-order test fences are sorted internally so bucketing still produces correct per-iteration counts. <!--#653f90e5a2456cd5-->
- `test_interleave_produces_fix_loop_timeline` (function) — Asserts that interleaving a full flow reorders sessions so each implement iteration appears chronologically between its corresponding test/self_check rounds. <!--#2c2d82f813e233c6-->
- `test_interleave_single_round_preserves_unchanged_implement` (function) — Asserts that a single-round implement session is emitted unchanged (no -iter suffix) when interleaved. <!--#c822263521a5029d-->
- `test_interleave_stable_sort_by_step_id_on_timestamp_tie` (function) — Asserts that sessions with identical first-message timestamps fall back to step_id as a stable tiebreaker during interleaving. <!--#cb4581ed968b3831-->
- `test_interleave_without_implement_acts_as_pure_sort` (function) — Asserts that with no implement session, interleaving degenerates to a plain chronological sort of the sessions. <!--#0df467d96f74442e-->
- `test_interleave_without_any_test_sessions_keeps_implement_whole` (function) — Asserts that with no test sessions to provide fences, the implement session is left whole and unsplit. <!--#8f2e87b5e8201f50-->
- `test_interleave_empty_implement_session_is_dropped` (function) — Asserts that an implement session with no messages produces no virtual sessions and is dropped from the interleaved output. <!--#385d7f3b2d6c21e3-->

### `tests/engine/test_confirm_revision_and_meta.py` (python) — Pytest module bundling StateMachine regression tests for CONFIRM-step behavior — bounded review/revise looping (no infinite loop on REVISION_NEEDED, max_iterations cap via persisted counter), correct already-confirmed detection from nested review_result, and the _write_flow_meta feature that records se3/python version and creation timestamp into _meta.json. <!--#47de1a3de3f1d5a4|e3a9430cba581803-->

  - `TestBugB_ConfirmRevisionNoInfiniteLoop.test_confirm_revision_calls_transition_to_next` (method) — Calls transition_to_next directly on a REVISION_NEEDED confirm and asserts it returns the reviewed PLAN step reset to PENDING for revision. <!--#7cd72b8756552a50-->
- `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection` (class) — Test class checking that already-confirmed detection reads the nested review_result structure so CONFIRM selects the correct (un-confirmed) step to review. <!--#6847a2d86522d7aa-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.setup_method` (method) — Creates a temp project root with a PersistenceManager and StateMachine before each test. <!--#70bd64e57dffc13b-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.teardown_method` (method) — Removes the temp directory after each test. <!--#c34398a3746e8dbf-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.test_already_confirmed_detected_with_nested_review_result` (method) — Asserts a second CONFIRM reviews IMPLEMENT rather than the already-approved PLAN, given the prior confirm's nested review_result. <!--#8f68141922ae98aa-->
  - `TestBugC_AlreadyConfirmedDetection.test_rejected_confirm_does_not_mark_step_confirmed` (method) — Regression test that a rejected (approved=False) confirm does not shield its reviewed PLAN, so the next CONFIRM re-reviews PLAN instead of sliding to an unconfigured later step and hitting the human fallback. <!--#1a7ef6a314d09888-->

- `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview` (class) — Test class verifying the LLM review↔revise loop is bounded by max_iterations using the persisted cross-revision counter (flow.state.review_iterations). <!--#2f8c3a1afdd8b1fb-->

  - `TestBoundedCrossRevisionReview.test_integration_revision_loop_is_bounded` (method) — End-to-end test with an always-rejecting mock LLM asserting the loop stops at max_iterations, auto-approves, re-runs plan the expected number of times, and completes the flow. <!--#89385792de63fef5-->

### `tests/engine/test_fix_loop.py` (python) — Unit and integration tests for the StateMachine fix-loop mechanism, covering iteration up to max_fix_iterations, propagation of fix context/instructions/iteration metadata to the implement step, TEST-step failures triggering REVISION_NEEDED, the end-to-end failure-to-reimplement workflow, and loading of the max_fix_iterations config from se3.yaml. <!--#8b29865488405010|1e493b1b52a8f2b7-->

  - `TestFixContextPassing.test_fix_context_passed_to_implement_step` (method) — Test that _transition_to_fix returns the implement step and copies the verify step's fix_context into its inputs. <!--#fc1a11c253cf3df6-->
  - `TestFixContextPassing.test_fix_instructions_passed_to_implement_step` (method) — Test that the fix_instructions string is propagated into the implement step's inputs on a fix transition. <!--#cc83f5f3918c4ef4-->
  - `TestFixContextPassing.test_is_fix_iteration_flag_set` (method) — Test that the implement step's inputs are marked with is_fix_iteration=True on a fix transition. <!--#ab6fd0c3d7b0aee9-->

  - `TestTestStepFailureHandling.test_test_step_stores_detailed_results_and_fix_context` (method) — Test that test_handler stores detailed test_results plus a fix_context flagged with test_failed and reason 'test_failure' on failure. <!--#47434e32cdd1e534-->

### `tests/engine/test_implement_dispatch_edge_cases.py` (python) — Unit tests covering edge cases in the IMPLEMENT step's dispatch logic, verifying which path (single LLM call, sequential group-by-group, or DAG parallel) is chosen and logged under conditions like linear-chain detection failures, empty repos, small LOC, single groups, and disabled worktrees. <!--#8e70e732df07b797|e8a19b7a11792edd-->
- `_make_step_flow` (function) — Helper that builds an IMPLEMENT Step and a FlowInstance from the given task groups for use across the dispatch edge-case tests. <!--#48c23ba8f854818f-->
- `TestLinearChainDetectionExceptionPath` (class) — Test class verifying that when linear-chain detection (transitive_reduce) raises, the exception is swallowed and DAG parallel still runs. <!--#9c29c0941f7ff6c9-->
  - `TestLinearChainDetectionExceptionPath.test_linear_chain_detection_raises_falls_through_to_dag` (method) — Asserts a linear chain that normally short-circuits still invokes _run_dag_parallel once when transitive_reduce raises RuntimeError. <!--#bf132b18df6735e4-->
- `TestHasCommitsFalseFallsThroughToSequential` (class) — Test class verifying that an empty repo (has_commits=False) skips DAG and falls through to the sequential group-by-group path even when DAG was selected. <!--#c47354db1e08b9b6-->
  - `TestHasCommitsFalseFallsThroughToSequential.test_empty_repo_skips_dag_and_runs_sequential` (method) — Asserts that with fork groups, use_worktree=True, and has_commits=False, _run_dag_parallel is not called and LLMCaller is invoked once per group sequentially. <!--#77627faf655d2d07-->
- `TestSmallLocPathIgnoresUseWorktree` (class) — Test class verifying that the small-LOC single-call merge path wins before dispatch runs, so use_worktree=False does not change its behavior. <!--#c93ca0e0d5d4aac1-->
  - `TestSmallLocPathIgnoresUseWorktree.test_small_loc_with_use_worktree_false_still_single_call` (method) — Asserts that small total LOC with use_worktree=False invokes _run_single_llm_call once and never reaches _run_dag_parallel. <!--#844643dbc8c3f2c3-->
- `TestSingleGroupNotEligibleForDag` (class) — Test class verifying that single-group inputs bypass DAG parallel regardless of the use_worktree setting. <!--#5ab351c8374c60ab-->
  - `TestSingleGroupNotEligibleForDag.test_single_group_with_use_worktree_true_never_uses_dag` (method) — Asserts that a single group with use_worktree=True takes the single-call path (since len(groups) < 2) and never calls _run_dag_parallel. <!--#4f7516b2ec539ab7-->
- `TestDispatchLogMessages` (class) — Test class verifying that dispatch short-circuits emit visible INFO logs explaining why DAG parallel was skipped, captured via caplog. <!--#c03928eb07d49e72-->
  - `TestDispatchLogMessages.test_use_worktree_false_logs_skip_message` (method) — Asserts an INFO log mentioning 'use_worktree=False' and 'sequential' is emitted when worktrees are disabled. <!--#4c63cb587cbf9b6b-->
  - `TestDispatchLogMessages.test_linear_chain_logs_fallback_message` (method) — Asserts an INFO log mentioning 'linear chain' and 'sequential' is emitted when a linear group chain short-circuits DAG parallel. <!--#f20f53607b796e5a-->

### `tests/engine/test_implement_execution_strategy.py` (python) — Unit tests verifying that implement_handler dispatches IMPLEMENT steps to the correct execution path—sequential, DAG-parallel, or a collapsed single LLM call—based on the use_worktree flag, group topology (fork vs. linear chain), and whether total LOC crosses the threshold. <!--#551f9007a1944547|17b212829a66cf7d-->
- `_make_step_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a minimal IMPLEMENT Step and FlowInstance pair seeded with the given task groups for use across the dispatch tests. <!--#28a04dc3937011f9-->
- `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch` (class) — Test class grouping the four cases exercising implement_handler's dispatch between sequential, DAG-parallel, and single-call execution paths. <!--#cb96dbaee6a009ce-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_use_worktree_false_forces_sequential_even_on_dag_eligible_groups` (method) — Asserts that with use_worktree=False, a DAG-eligible fork group above the LOC threshold still runs sequentially (one LLMCaller per group, no DAG call). <!--#82ff1938d841625e-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_linear_chain_falls_back_to_sequential` (method) — Asserts that use_worktree=True with a linear group chain above the LOC threshold short-circuits to sequential execution rather than DAG parallel. <!--#eb82a5ee0fa03595-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_fork_dag_uses_dag_parallel` (method) — Asserts that use_worktree=True with a fork DAG above the LOC threshold dispatches to _run_dag_parallel exactly once. <!--#86d840f8b6e21973-->
  - `TestExecutionStrategyDispatch.test_small_multi_group_collapses_to_single_call` (method) — Asserts that use_worktree=True with total LOC below the threshold collapses multiple groups into a single LLM call (via _run_single_llm_call) rather than DAG or per-group sequential execution. <!--#647fbce8c13d4d0b-->

  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_use_worktree_false_reports_reason` (method) — Asserts that with use_worktree=False the handler falls back to sequential and reports the reason 'use_worktree=False'. <!--#3d79d4cf40fa6722-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_linear_chain_reports_reason` (method) — Asserts that a linear-chain plan falls back to sequential and reports the reason 'linear chain'. <!--#393d27aadd7f12de-->

  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_small_loc_merge_no_sequential_reason` (method) — Asserts that a small multi-group plan merges via the 'single' path so no 'sequential' display call (and thus no sequential_reason) is emitted. <!--#65d8e5f77d6abf0b-->
  - `TestSequentialReasonPropagation.test_fork_dag_no_sequential_display` (method) — Asserts that a forking DAG plan takes the dag_parallel path and never triggers a sequential display call. <!--#7e62ebd663a20bbc-->
- `TestDisplayTaskPlanForwards` (class) — Test class verifying the _display_task_plan wrapper forwards sequential_reason (and strategy) through to the TaskFormatter's format_implement_plan. <!--#cc37775f27e47fa7-->
  - `TestDisplayTaskPlanForwards.test_forwards_sequential_reason_to_formatter` (method) — Asserts _display_task_plan passes the given sequential_reason and execution_strategy to format_implement_plan. <!--#a8a93cb93a7e2463-->
  - `TestDisplayTaskPlanForwards.test_default_sequential_reason_is_none` (method) — Asserts that omitting sequential_reason forwards None to format_implement_plan. <!--#0481b1f47676e06c-->

### `tests/engine/test_llm_caller_step_override.py` (python) — Pytest module verifying the LLMCaller's agent-chain selection priority: an explicit `agents=` argument wins over a per-step `llm_caller.steps.<step>` override, which is used verbatim (no default 'claude' fallback appended) and raises LLMCallError on exhaustion rather than rotating into the default chain, while steps without an override fall back to the default single-'claude' chain. <!--#cd0c200e72238854|101a184685881979-->

  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_multiple_duplicate_blocks` (method) — Asserts multiple distinct repeated blocks are each deduplicated independently with separators preserved. <!--#d71c411d543a0310-->
  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_short_repeat_not_deduplicated` (method) — Asserts blocks shorter than the default min_block_lines (3) are left untouched. <!--#6d49f8ee57305ea5-->
  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_custom_min_block_lines` (method) — Asserts passing min_block_lines=2 deduplicates two-line repeated blocks. <!--#80306b0a30cb5d0f-->

  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_first_call_noop` (method) — Asserts a typical first-call prompt with no internal repetition is returned unchanged. <!--#c66d964c6b6337af-->
  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_realistic_retry_prompt` (method) — Asserts repeated spec content in a simulated retry prompt collapses to one full occurrence plus a marker. <!--#0e179612a9647ebe-->
  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_min_block_lines_one` (method) — Asserts min_block_lines=1 deduplicates single repeated lines. <!--#f0b2ce7ababbc158-->
  - `TestDeduplicatePromptLines.test_large_prompt_performance` (method) — Asserts dedup of a 5000-line prompt completes under 5 seconds and replaces the four redundant spec blocks. <!--#a8fe4eeaa11c250e-->

### `tests/engine/test_retry_context_safety_cap.py` (python) — Test module validating the retry context-management pipeline — dedup of repeated spec/tool-result text, the post-dedup safety cap that truncates non-dedupable history while preserving the new-prompt tail, separator/marker anchoring on retries-of-retries, end-to-end wiring into LLMCaller._call_with_retry, and literal-'\n' preprocessing. <!--#bb693c199cf2a518|3334ef73f5ac708b-->
- `_make_session` (function) — Test helper that wraps a list of ChatMessages in a ChatSession with fixed flow/step/type identifiers. <!--#c890988af505c899-->
- `_big_spec_block` (function) — Test helper that builds a deterministic ~130K-char multi-line spec text block to exercise dedup and the safety cap. <!--#db69d4f20851724e-->
- `TestRepeatedSpecNoTruncation` (class) — Test class for scenario (a): repeated spec text is collapsed by dedup and not cut by per-prompt truncation. <!--#c9bdef5aafd018e1-->
  - `TestRepeatedSpecNoTruncation.test_repeated_spec_not_truncated_by_format_history` (method) — Asserts format_history_for_retry() preserves the full original spec body and emits no safety-limit truncation warning. <!--#1ff35f0801fd901c-->
  - `TestRepeatedSpecNoTruncation.test_dedup_eliminates_repetition_below_safety_limit` (method) — Asserts that dedup substantially shrinks a doubly-repeated spec prompt below the safety limit, leaving the cap a no-op and the new-prompt tail intact. <!--#23a6af1e5ac7a8b0-->
- `TestPostDedupSafetyCap` (class) — Test class for scenario (b): the post-dedup _post_dedup_safety_cap fallback truncating non-dedupable history while preserving the new-prompt tail. <!--#682bb2311d928158-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_noop_when_under_limit` (method) — Asserts the cap leaves a small marker/separator prompt unchanged when under the limit. <!--#e6ec454720c716fa-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_noop_when_no_history_marker` (method) — Asserts the cap refuses to truncate an oversized prompt that lacks the retry-history marker. <!--#4a70f2ed500af6db-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_truncates_history_head_preserves_tail` (method) — Asserts the cap truncates the history head to a strict length bound while preserving the separator/new-prompt tail and emitting a warning. <!--#1c218da37ad48999-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_preserves_tail_even_when_tail_exceeds_limit` (method) — Asserts that when the tail alone exceeds the limit, the cap keeps the tail intact, tolerates over-limit size, and logs a distinguishing (not generic) warning. <!--#0b6c1df08ec5aa6b-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_warns_when_separator_missing` (method) — Asserts that with the marker present but separator missing, the cap returns the prompt unchanged and logs the observable failure. <!--#bee6fdf2909ba134-->
  - `TestPostDedupSafetyCap.test_cap_kept_body_starts_at_line_boundary` (method) — Asserts the cap rounds its kept-body slice forward to a newline boundary so truncation never starts mid-line. <!--#9c9141937a8699b8-->
- `TestRetryOfRetryAnchoring` (class) — Test class guarding that on a retry-of-retry the cap anchors on the outer separator (rfind), not an inner replayed one. <!--#aa7c368c632db022-->
  - `TestRetryOfRetryAnchoring.test_cap_anchors_outer_separator_on_retry_of_retry` (method) — Asserts that with nested marker/separator blocks the cap anchors on the outer separator so the new-prompt tail survives and invariants hold. <!--#79fcb70181e6eb2f-->
- `TestCallWithRetryInvokesSafetyCap` (class) — End-to-end test class verifying LLMCaller._call_with_retry actually wires _post_dedup_safety_cap into the retry path. <!--#a68efded05e3a78d-->
  - `TestCallWithRetryInvokesSafetyCap.test_safety_cap_called_on_retry_path` (method) — Asserts the cap is called once on a retry path with an effective prompt carrying both the marker and separator. <!--#8145214e4495bc1f-->
  - `TestCallWithRetryInvokesSafetyCap.test_safety_cap_not_called_on_first_call` (method) — Asserts the cap (and dedup) are skipped entirely on a first, non-retry call. <!--#5a788035898f493d-->
- `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing` (class) — Test class covering the backslash-n preprocessing that splits JSON-embedded literal '\n' content into real lines so dedup can collapse it. <!--#0bed9eec699b8c5e-->
  - `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing.test_replace_lets_dedup_collapse_embedded_blocks` (method) — Asserts dedup misses repeated embedded multi-line tool_result content without the '\n' replace but hits it afterward. <!--#864099dc5971dea6-->
  - `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing.test_replace_does_not_touch_real_newlines` (method) — Asserts the '\n' replace is idempotent on strings that already contain only real newlines. <!--#93cfc0631f8f5793-->
  - `TestDedupLiteralNewlinePreprocessing.test_replace_does_not_touch_other_escapes` (method) — Asserts the replace converts only literal '\n' and leaves other escapes like '\t', '\\', and '\"' intact. <!--#f6a6373e104c2e75-->

### `tests/engine/test_retry_continuation.py` (python) — Unit tests for the engine's retry/resume behavior, covering LLMCaller's retry_mode (continue vs. retry) prompt shaping, injection of is_retry/retry_count metadata into step inputs, load_or_create_flow treating FAILED flows as resumable, and init_flow idempotency across FAILED/PAUSED/COMPLETED flows. <!--#61cb23dd21ce97e8|36f3a19a525e3552-->

  - `TestLLMCallerRetryMode.test_retry_mode_stored` (method) — Asserts an explicit retry_mode argument is stored as an instance attribute. <!--#bd978db1dae1e8eb-->

  - `TestLLMCallerRetryMode.test_retry_mode_uses_original_prompt` (method) — Verifies that in retry mode a retry prepends history context and re-appends the original prompt. <!--#bf447af7b5d46b58-->
  - `TestLLMCallerRetryMode.test_first_attempt_unchanged` (method) — Verifies the first attempt (external_attempt=0) uses the original prompt with no retry context and never fetches retry context. <!--#72117a680728db9c-->
  - `TestLLMCallerRetryMode.test_get_retry_context_passes_mode` (method) — Verifies _get_retry_context forwards self.retry_mode and iteration to format_history_for_retry. <!--#deae3b02caaafb22-->
- `TestStateMachineRetryMetadata` (class) — Test class covering injection of is_retry/retry_count metadata into a step's inputs on retry. <!--#e0dc7ed0e41dff4d-->
  - `TestStateMachineRetryMetadata.test_retry_injects_metadata` (method) — Asserts that retrying a failed step sets is_retry=True and retry_count in its inputs. <!--#c703dc2eec2a6468-->
  - `TestStateMachineRetryMetadata.test_first_execution_no_retry_metadata` (method) — Asserts a freshly created step carries no is_retry or retry_count metadata. <!--#6283e0766efaa122-->
- `TestStateMachineLoadOrCreateFailedFlow` (class) — Test class covering load_or_create_flow treating FAILED flows as resumable versus creating new flows. <!--#792602b2e696d06c-->
  - `TestStateMachineLoadOrCreateFailedFlow.test_load_or_create_returns_resumed_for_failed_flow` (method) — Asserts load_or_create_flow returns the existing flow with is_resumed=True for a FAILED flow. <!--#57ca468eb74370c4-->
  - `TestStateMachineLoadOrCreateFailedFlow.test_load_or_create_creates_new_for_completed_flow` (method) — Asserts load_or_create_flow creates a fresh flow (is_resumed=False) when the prior flow is COMPLETED. <!--#edf6c379309f3665-->
- `TestInitFlowIdempotency` (class) — Test class verifying init_flow is safe and idempotent for FAILED, PAUSED, and COMPLETED flows. <!--#5047c08da7d3b47a-->
  - `TestInitFlowIdempotency.test_init_flow_safe_for_failed_flow` (method) — Asserts init_flow on a FAILED flow still writes meta and records the baseline commit once. <!--#2827cba4db8276b3-->
  - `TestInitFlowIdempotency.test_init_flow_safe_for_paused_flow` (method) — Asserts init_flow on a PAUSED flow writes meta and records the baseline commit once. <!--#462a284c734940e9-->
  - `TestInitFlowIdempotency.test_init_flow_safe_for_completed_flow` (method) — Asserts init_flow on a COMPLETED flow writes meta and records the baseline commit once. <!--#11307cb05347f60b-->

### `tests/engine/test_retry_count_reset.py` (python) — Test suite pinning the reset of the stale `retry_count` input at the three new-call transition sites (fix-loop, revision, and discovery user-response), plus unit tests for the `_reset_retry_counter_for_new_call` helper, to prevent LLMCaller from mistaking a fresh prompt for a retry. <!--#65d291975fe41a18|ebae87be20cb5cb3-->
- `TestResetHelper` (class) — Tests for the `_reset_retry_counter_for_new_call` helper in isolation, covering both the present and absent cases. <!--#bcbf858bc82be8d0-->
  - `TestResetHelper.test_pops_retry_count_when_present` (method) — Asserts the helper removes `retry_count` from a step's inputs while leaving other input keys untouched. <!--#1bcf7e8fdf830fc1-->
  - `TestResetHelper.test_noop_when_absent` (method) — Asserts the helper is a safe no-op (no error, other keys kept) when `retry_count` is not present. <!--#d2eaa0f6ce2a10fb-->
- `_build_flow_with_implement_fix` (function) — Test fixture builder that constructs a flow with a completed IMPLEMENT step and a VERIFY_SPEC step in REVISION_NEEDED, seeding a given `retry_count`, to exercise the fix-loop transition. <!--#c2ce0596a5525e9f-->
- `TestFixLoopResetsRetryCount` (class) — Tests that `StateMachine._transition_to_fix` clears `retry_count` on the target step while preserving the fix-iteration inputs. <!--#59befedc430db817-->
  - `TestFixLoopResetsRetryCount.test_stale_retry_count_cleared_on_fix_iteration` (method) — Verifies a stale `retry_count` is removed and the fix-iteration flags (`is_fix_iteration`, `fix_instructions`) are still set after a fix transition. <!--#34c14025a92a2460-->
  - `TestFixLoopResetsRetryCount.test_no_retry_count_stays_absent_after_fix_iteration` (method) — Baseline check that a fix transition does not inject `retry_count` when none was present beforehand. <!--#c4b60ec891d14713-->
- `_build_flow_with_plan_revision` (function) — Test fixture builder that constructs a flow with a completed PLAN step and a CONFIRM step in REVISION_NEEDED, seeding a given `retry_count`, to exercise the revision transition. <!--#8be01dda26b7554b-->
- `TestRevisionResetsRetryCount` (class) — Tests that `StateMachine._transition_to_revision` clears `retry_count` on the revised step while preserving the revision inputs. <!--#0f399443c76f62e2-->
  - `TestRevisionResetsRetryCount.test_stale_retry_count_cleared_on_revision` (method) — Verifies a stale `retry_count` is removed and the revision flags (`is_revision`, `revision_feedback`) remain set after a revision transition. <!--#da275b0df18fbd65-->
- `TestDiscoveryUserResponseResetsRetryCount` (class) — Tests that the discovery round-advance branch in run.py clears `retry_count` when the user replies, both behaviorally and via source-level inspection. <!--#ce7a367f77dd47fa-->
  - `TestDiscoveryUserResponseResetsRetryCount.test_user_response_path_clears_stale_retry_count` (method) — Reproduces the run-loop discovery user-response mutations on a PAUSED discovery step and asserts the four state changes including the `retry_count` pop. <!--#34309fbd9dd176ba-->
  - `TestDiscoveryUserResponseResetsRetryCount.test_run_py_branch_source_does_the_reset` (method) — Source-level regression guard that inspects run.py to confirm the discovery user-response branch actually contains the `pop("retry_count", None)` call. <!--#91d2124f091710c3-->

### `tests/engine/test_runtime_environment_injection.py` (python) — Unit and end-to-end tests for context_builder.get_runtime_environment_injection, verifying the default step whitelist, FORBIDDEN-step precedence, yaml override narrowing/widening, malformed/null yaml fallback, missing-markdown graceful warn-once behavior, markdown caching, and that the injection reaches the final LLM prompt. <!--#22dd5ed11f64795c|e00e6a1ae17c693b-->
- `_reset_cache` (function) — Autouse fixture that resets the runtime-environment markdown cache before and after each test so file-removal and load-count assertions are isolated. <!--#2491e76944ff0f32-->
- `test_default_whitelist_returns_full_content` (function) — Asserts a whitelisted step's injection contains the heading and all required whitelist commands, blacklist commands, path references, and workflow hints. <!--#64c7b388e1cc5d71-->
- `test_forbidden_steps_always_return_empty_even_with_yaml` (function) — Verifies FORBIDDEN steps (commit, version_analyze) yield empty injection even when explicitly listed in se3.yaml, while a co-listed allowed step still gets injection. <!--#47a1a0f6aeef99d6-->
- `test_yaml_override_narrows_and_widens_whitelist` (function) — Checks that a yaml steps override replaces the default whitelist (narrowing and widening) while FORBIDDEN steps remain empty. <!--#7de7adf80e9fc48a-->
- `test_missing_markdown_returns_empty_and_warns_once` (function) — Monkeypatches the markdown loader to a nonexistent path to confirm missing markdown returns empty without raising and logs exactly one warning across multiple calls. <!--#37baf98d96e0f645-->
- `test_null_yaml_falls_back_to_defaults` (function) — Ensures an explicit `runtime_environment_injection: null` in yaml does not crash and falls back to the default whitelist. <!--#6b9f1dc35277d923-->
- `test_non_list_yaml_override_ignored` (function) — Confirms a non-list steps value (bare string) is ignored in favor of defaults, preventing accidental substring-match whitelisting. <!--#e696f4bf51b2555d-->
- `test_defaults_cover_expected_steps` (function) — Sanity-checks that all LLM-free-decision steps are in the default whitelist and that mechanical steps are forbidden and absent from defaults. <!--#7eff29e44630c897-->
- `test_markdown_is_cached_across_calls` (function) — Counts Path.read_text calls to verify the runtime-environment markdown is read from disk only once across multiple injection calls. <!--#38bb79dda4eabcbd-->
- `test_runtime_env_appears_in_prompt_end_to_end` (function) — End-to-end test patching LLMCaller in implement_handler to confirm the runtime-environment injection (heading plus representative whitelist/blacklist commands) reaches the final LLM prompt. <!--#42226a7fe7c04d0a-->

### `tests/engine/test_self_check_defer_fix.py` (python) — Unit tests for the self_check defer-fix mechanism, covering WorkflowConfig threshold parsing, issue merge/dedup, deferral vs. immediate-fix arbitration (critical/high severity, count thresholds, chain-tail flush, cross-pass signature dedup, threshold-disabled behavior), and the regression that convergence never bypasses defer/fix handling. <!--#de6c3ad797bd6e62|fd77f7edfaf485e5-->
- `_valid_issue` (function) — Helper that builds a self_check issue dict shaped to survive _validate_and_filter_issues, with configurable severity, path, and source quote. <!--#edd9f2bd98d54935-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that constructs a minimal RUNNING feature FlowInstance for the tests. <!--#39911d8baec83067-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Helper that builds a SELF_CHECK Step with inputs parameterized by pass index, passes-required, defer threshold, and deferred stash. <!--#c56ce8ea0dcdfb81-->
- `_run_handler` (function) — Helper that invokes self_check_handler with LLMCaller mocked to return the supplied issues. <!--#22f52d89551622c6-->
- `TestDeferThresholdConfig` (class) — Test class verifying WorkflowConfig parsing of self_check_defer_fix_threshold (default, explicit, disable, type coercion, and fail-fast). <!--#a0269715d8069a8f-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_default_is_three` (method) — Asserts the threshold defaults to 3 and matches the DEFAULT_SELF_CHECK_DEFER_FIX_THRESHOLD constant. <!--#edac73f7849385a2-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_explicit_value` (method) — Asserts an explicit threshold value is preserved from config. <!--#d66fbab3fd7131d2-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_zero_disables` (method) — Asserts a threshold of 0 disables deferral. <!--#1be4c65bb90f7b8d-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_null_disables` (method) — Asserts a null threshold is normalized to 0 (deferral disabled). <!--#7f31634d67751d3a-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_bool_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a boolean threshold warns and falls back to the default of 3. <!--#a37270887e84ea21-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_float_warns_and_falls_back` (method) — Asserts a float threshold warns and falls back to the default of 3. <!--#bad7932f1b07a456-->
  - `TestDeferThresholdConfig.test_negative_fails_fast` (method) — Asserts a negative threshold raises ConfigError. <!--#5eee044670d60ef6-->
- `TestMergeDedup` (class) — Test class for the issue merge/dedup helpers (_merge_dedup_issues and _issue_signature). <!--#17cb9a5514fcbe31-->
  - `TestMergeDedup.test_dedup_drops_matching_signature` (method) — Asserts merging drops a duplicate issue sharing the same signature while keeping distinct ones. <!--#88c272c1966f24e5-->
  - `TestMergeDedup.test_unsignable_issue_kept` (method) — Asserts issues that produce no signature are not deduplicated (all kept). <!--#dde7aa76f97edb26-->
- `TestDeferTriggered` (class) — Test class verifying that few non-critical issues with a later pass remaining are deferred rather than fixed. <!--#7194c40cc2d174f8-->
  - `TestDeferTriggered.test_few_noncritical_issues_defer` (method) — Asserts below-threshold non-critical issues with a subsequent pass return COMPLETED and stash the issues without entering the fix loop. <!--#f6108c5c5626f049-->
- `TestCriticalHighImmediateFix` (class) — Test class verifying critical/high-severity issues trigger immediate REVISION_NEEDED including any accumulated stash. <!--#c95f3a957efed0f3-->
  - `TestCriticalHighImmediateFix.test_high_severity_immediate_fix` (method) — Asserts a high-severity issue immediately enters the fix loop with the issue in fix_context. <!--#06f4b6ea03f0d5d7-->
  - `TestCriticalHighImmediateFix.test_critical_with_accumulated_stash` (method) — Asserts a critical issue flushes both the prior stash and the current issue into one consolidated fix. <!--#4ca684a1b3ab0e06-->
- `TestThresholdReachedImmediateFix` (class) — Test class verifying that reaching the issue-count threshold forces an immediate fix. <!--#cd6fb71807e72bc3-->
  - `TestThresholdReachedImmediateFix.test_count_at_threshold_fixes_now` (method) — Asserts an issue count equal to the threshold yields REVISION_NEEDED rather than deferral. <!--#ef673dab18df92f5-->
- `TestChainTailMergeIntoFix` (class) — Test class verifying the last pass flushes the stash (merged with current issues) into a single fix. <!--#647a1dc05f1ec249-->
  - `TestChainTailMergeIntoFix.test_last_pass_merges_stash_and_current` (method) — Asserts the final pass merges a stashed issue and a fresh sub-threshold issue into one fix since no later pass can defer. <!--#7e151495bd26fabe-->
  - `TestChainTailMergeIntoFix.test_clean_last_pass_flushes_stash` (method) — Asserts a clean last pass with a non-empty stash still flushes the stash into a fix. <!--#819707c89e27d9b8-->

  - `TestSignatureDedupAcrossPasses.test_duplicate_dropped_when_merging_into_fix` (method) — Asserts a re-reported stashed issue is deduped so the merged fix list contains the unique issues only. <!--#01450eeafae7bb0c-->

  - `TestConvergenceSubordinateToDefer.test_accumulated_stash_not_discarded_by_convergence` (method) — Asserts a pending stash blocks the convergence shortcut so a converged non-last pass defers (stash grows) instead of dropping findings. <!--#976323e1a98b1979-->
  - `TestConvergenceSubordinateToDefer.test_below_threshold_no_stash_tail_pass_enters_fix_not_converged` (method) — Asserts a below-threshold converged tail pass with no stash enters the fix loop rather than converging-and-dropping. <!--#b8465ab1fa0dda9d-->
  - `TestConvergenceSubordinateToDefer.test_below_threshold_no_stash_nonlast_pass_defers_not_converged` (method) — Asserts a below-threshold converged non-last pass with no stash defers the finding rather than dropping it via convergence. <!--#efd4b4ea8070b6a6-->
  - `TestConvergenceSubordinateToDefer.test_convergence_still_applies_when_deferral_disabled` (method) — Asserts the legacy convergence shortcut still returns a converged COMPLETED when deferral is disabled (threshold=0). <!--#0edeb6387dc0cade-->
- `_make_state_machine` (function) — Helper that constructs a StateMachine with PersistenceManager patched and the workflow-config getter stubbed. <!--#32da48745284b514-->

  - `TestStashLifecycle.test_stash_carries_forward_across_passes` (method) — Asserts the deferred stash carries forward and grows across successive SELF_CHECK passes via transition_to_next. <!--#b6748654b7d463d6-->

### `tests/engine/test_self_check_state_machine.py` (python) — Unit/integration tests for the StateMachine's handling of the SELF_CHECK (code review) step, covering its fix-loop routing on REVISION_NEEDED, fix-history/source logging, input/output assembly, presence in default step sequences, and step-handler registration. <!--#9a998ecf845ab5b1|9d2762ed4c1a7b5a-->

  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_revision_sets_implement_fix_inputs` (method) — Asserts the fix loop populates the implement step's inputs with the fix-iteration flag, iteration number, self-check fix instructions, and self_check fix-context reason. <!--#933299815a923e8d-->

  - `TestSelfCheckTransitionToNext.test_self_check_shares_fix_iteration_with_test_and_verify` (method) — Asserts SELF_CHECK fix triggers increment the same global fix-iteration counter shared with TEST and VERIFY_SPEC across successive revisions. <!--#a36abf80a6bbfa30-->

### `tests/engine/test_spec_diff_fallback_guard.py` (python) — Unit tests for the spec-diff fallback guard that fails IMPLEMENT (and other non-exempt) steps which write spec files via a Bash bypass invisible to the PreToolUse hook, covering the exemption set, config gating, and end-to-end StateMachine.run_step behavior. <!--#5a4476ff3e1e1364|00a80585cfb1c41e-->

  - `TestRunStepDiffGuard.test_handler_failure_keeps_original_error` (method) — Asserts a handler that both writes a spec and raises keeps its own error message, since the guard only overrides a non-FAILED status. <!--#709e9668bfe045de-->

### `tests/engine/test_spec_validator.py` (python) — Unit-test suite for se3.engine.spec_validator that exercises all five v1 structural rules (marker, heading, Purpose, Requirement, narrative-prose rejection) with positive/negative cases, plus real-world fixtures and the extract_spec_body narrative-stripping helper. <!--#0f49f49d65ebe4be|be39546f8b5e38f3-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_baseline.py` (python) — Baseline-behavior unit tests for the StateMachine engine, covering git HEAD baseline-commit recording, output forwarding between VERSION_ANALYZE/COMMIT and IMPLEMENT/VERSION_ANALYZE steps, and the composition of effective task descriptions (discovery-refined text plus user interjections) used both for fresh steps and fix-loop re-entry. <!--#ac228a081bab7cb0|478163e9e0d6c151-->

  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_record_baseline_commit_persists_flow` (method) — Asserts the flow is persisted via persistence.save_flow after the baseline commit is recorded. <!--#ce02bd45c80c313c-->
  - `TestBaselineCommitRecording.test_init_flow_calls_record_baseline_commit` (method) — Asserts init_flow() invokes _record_baseline_commit during flow initialization. <!--#47668408b663f1b6-->

  - `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding.test_version_analyze_outputs_forwarded_to_commit` (method) — Asserts bump_type, reasoning, confidence, and suggested_version flow from VERSION_ANALYZE outputs into COMMIT inputs. <!--#6936a8f7773152cc-->
  - `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding.test_version_analyze_not_forwarded_when_absent` (method) — Asserts VERSION_ANALYZE keys are absent from COMMIT inputs when no such step has run. <!--#66cb53c0e64f7198-->
  - `TestVersionAnalyzeForwarding.test_version_analyze_partial_outputs_forwarded` (method) — Asserts partial VERSION_ANALYZE outputs are forwarded with missing keys defaulting to None. <!--#bd51e8e0f284b380-->

  - `TestImplementSessionCommitsForwarding.test_session_commits_forwarded_to_version_analyze` (method) — Asserts pre_session_version and the session_commits list propagate from IMPLEMENT into VERSION_ANALYZE inputs. <!--#55d9db3505b70a62-->
  - `TestImplementSessionCommitsForwarding.test_session_commits_default_empty_list_when_missing` (method) — Asserts an older IMPLEMENT step lacking these outputs yields pre_session_version=None and session_commits=[] rather than missing keys. <!--#77cc63e49dd8c75d-->

### `tests/engine/test_state_machine_baseline_failures.py` (python) — Unit tests for the StateMachine's pre-implement test-baseline wiring (G3): launching/caching baseline capture, ensuring it's ready before IMPLEMENT with sync/empty fallbacks, cleanup, run_step gating, and injecting baseline_failures into TEST step inputs. <!--#17fde00a48cc7a4f|84848daf1e31f612-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Helper that builds a fresh feature-type FlowInstance for use as a test fixture. <!--#32a40d3cc61515b7-->

- `TestStartBaselineCapture` (class) — Test class covering _start_baseline_capture: cache hit, cache miss launching background capture, resume skip, and launch-failure safety. <!--#c2ca53f1b7cce721-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_cache_hit_skips_background_launch` (method) — Asserts a cache hit populates baseline_failures from cache and launches no background capture. <!--#ec2131d20577e2ec-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_cache_miss_launches_background_capture` (method) — Asserts a cache miss launches a background capture and leaves baseline state unmeasured (None) until later resolution. <!--#93133cbf9b178330-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_resume_with_existing_baseline_does_not_relaunch` (method) — Asserts a resumed flow with an already-measured baseline neither recomputes the key nor relaunches capture. <!--#1206af5dbed0965f-->
  - `TestStartBaselineCapture.test_launch_failure_does_not_raise` (method) — Asserts an exception during capture startup is swallowed, leaving baseline_failures None without raising. <!--#17f8c291e912867d-->
- `TestEnsureBaselineReady` (class) — Test class covering _ensure_baseline_ready: idempotency, background success, sync fallback, no-handle/double-fail/timeout degradation, and cache writeback. <!--#a4575554336d1acb-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_idempotent_when_already_measured` (method) — Asserts an already-measured baseline causes no wait and leaves the value unchanged. <!--#65f5014c4333e224-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_success_sets_sorted_baseline` (method) — Asserts a successful background result sets a sorted baseline, saves the cache, and clears the capture handle. <!--#c7662e31944e37eb-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_none_triggers_sync_fallback` (method) — Asserts a None background result triggers a synchronous re-measurement that yields the authoritative baseline. <!--#e9b87d5e4a3fb42b-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_no_handle_runs_sync_fallback` (method) — Asserts that with no background capture handle (e.g. earlier launch failure) the synchronous fallback runs. <!--#a72c8e10c85644f5-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_both_paths_fail_uses_empty_baseline` (method) — Asserts that when both background and sync captures fail, the baseline degrades to an empty list rather than None. <!--#1e4e61c6c71110cb-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_background_timeout_skips_sync_and_uses_empty_baseline` (method) — Asserts a timed-out (hung-and-killed) background capture skips the sync fallback and degrades straight to an empty baseline. <!--#d8ebb481d0e197b3-->
  - `TestEnsureBaselineReady.test_resolved_baseline_written_to_cache` (method) — Asserts the resolved baseline is persisted via save_cache with the correct key and failures set. <!--#b25b3d1c9294de46-->
- `TestCleanupBaselineCapture` (class) — Test class covering cleanup_baseline_capture: killing a still-running capture, no-op when absent or already reaped, and swallowing kill errors. <!--#f6fd4d2d343fecfc-->
  - `TestCleanupBaselineCapture.test_kills_still_running_capture` (method) — Asserts an early-abort flow's still-held background capture is killed and its handle cleared. <!--#943438d7e34ea393-->

  - `TestRunStepBaselineWiring.test_implement_triggers_ensure_baseline` (method) — Asserts running an IMPLEMENT step calls _ensure_baseline_ready exactly once with the flow. <!--#b348a9d6aafcb599-->

  - `TestRunStepBaselineWiring.test_fix_loop_reentry_does_not_remeasure` (method) — Asserts a fix-loop re-entry into IMPLEMENT with an existing baseline hits the idempotent guard and constructs no new capture. <!--#4a581bd5f2036854-->
- `TestBuildStepInputsBaselineInjection` (class) — Test class verifying _build_step_inputs injects baseline_failures into TEST inputs (as [] when uncaptured) and passes a defensive copy. <!--#e4b19923113a629f-->

### `tests/engine/test_task_description_composer.py` (python) — Unit tests for the task-description composer that appends user interjections as a bracketed-prefix bullet section to a base task, covering empty/whitespace handling, ordering, stripping, skipping malformed or empty entries, and the various step/timestamp prefix forms. <!--#5d7a511c99d38133|003ab16606465f9b-->

### `tests/engine/test_test_step_timeout_retry.py` (python) — Unit tests for the TEST step's two behaviors: a primary-command timeout triggering a single in-place retry (and entering a timeout-labeled fix loop only if it times out again), and the slimming of a passed phase's archived stdout into a compact count+tail summary while failed phases keep full output. <!--#43eba96ef561a891|48b480f848d8ac62-->

  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_still_timeout_enters_fix_with_timeout_label` (method) — Asserts two consecutive timeouts enter the fix loop with timeout-not-assertion labeling and the canonical reason text. <!--#9ad7c704fac9c2a4-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_does_not_increment_fix_iteration` (method) — Asserts the in-place retry does not bump the fix-iteration counter and runs exactly once. <!--#316107c3b1a40cba-->

  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_required_phase_timeout_is_retried_once` (method) — Asserts a required configured phase that times out gets the same one-shot retry and recovers without a fix loop. <!--#0db645eea5ecbc2c-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_persistent_required_phase_timeout_labels_fix_context` (method) — Asserts a required phase timing out twice enters the fix loop with timeout-not-assertion metadata naming the phase. <!--#fc74e02e4f275e7c-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_returncode_minus_one_without_marker_is_retried` (method) — Asserts a bare returncode -1 result with no flag or marker is still recognized as a timeout and retried. <!--#02df188980050f87-->

  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_retry_passes_with_timeout_stderr_not_recorded_as_timeout` (method) — Asserts a passing retry that echoes a timeout marker is not classified as a persistent timeout failure. <!--#5b2df7ada0236793-->
  - `TestTimeoutRetry.test_exception_fallback_returncode_minus_two_not_retried` (method) — Asserts the subprocess-spawn-exception fallback (returncode -2) is not misclassified as a timeout and is not retried. <!--#ac3a041bbeaceac0-->

### `tests/engine/test_verify_spec_renderer.py` (python) — Unit tests for the VERIFY_SPEC step renderer, checking that the summary and recommendations are sourced from top-level outputs with fallback to the nested verification_result dict, and that issue priorities map to well-formed Rich close tags. <!--#2aad234df505ac09|17e1e29728c5483e-->

- `TestSummaryFallback` (class) — Test class verifying the renderer derives the summary from top-level outputs, falls back to nested verification_result, and tolerates missing or non-dict values. <!--#337baacc7b992ffd-->
  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_reads_from_nested_verification_result` (method) — Asserts the summary is read from outputs['verification_result']['summary'] when no top-level summary exists. <!--#6283d975621d7f5b-->
  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_toplevel_takes_precedence` (method) — Asserts a top-level summary is used and the nested verification_result summary is ignored. <!--#f06c9175bec72902-->
  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_no_summary_anywhere` (method) — Asserts the renderer still emits a PASSED result when no summary is present anywhere. <!--#20d63b61972b2d03-->
  - `TestSummaryFallback.test_verification_result_not_dict` (method) — Asserts the renderer does not crash when verification_result is a string instead of a dict. <!--#3bbcb095139a336d-->
- `TestRecommendationsFallback` (class) — Test class verifying recommendations are sourced from top-level outputs with fallback to the nested verification_result dict. <!--#60338754984fc417-->
  - `TestRecommendationsFallback.test_reads_from_nested_verification_result` (method) — Asserts recommendations are read from the nested verification_result when no top-level recommendations exist. <!--#4d6290d21205c34b-->
  - `TestRecommendationsFallback.test_toplevel_takes_precedence` (method) — Asserts top-level recommendations are used and nested verification_result recommendations are ignored. <!--#8ff35b98a2dac7d6-->
- `TestRichCloseTag` (class) — Test class verifying issue priorities map to correctly-formed Rich close tags without an extra trailing bracket. <!--#dc905f075be3c1d4-->
  - `TestRichCloseTag.test_red_close_tag_for_high_priority` (method) — Asserts a high-priority issue produces a well-formed [/red] close tag with no stray bracket. <!--#da981b37d75a73e5-->

  - `TestRichCloseTag.test_dim_close_tag_for_low_priority` (method) — Asserts a low-priority issue produces a well-formed [/dim] close tag with no stray bracket. <!--#4f3eff3532513d94-->
  - `TestRichCloseTag.test_all_priorities_correct_tags` (method) — Asserts that all four priority levels together yield correct close tags with no malformed double-bracket variants. <!--#7f4a8cf71b496795-->

## `tests/engine/steps/` — Unit and integration test suite for se3's engine step handlers, exhaustively covering the COMMIT step (version resolution/auto-repair, change detection, message and docs generation, root-whitelist guard) and the IMPLEMENT step (resume idempotency, DAG parallel execution and cleanup, merge robustness, session-commit and version re-entry invariants, restricted edits, history salvage), plus the PLAN step's retirement of spec-governance machinery. <!--#a47a8a0c97aedfc8|b729dfbec36a06cf-->

### `tests/engine/steps/__init__.py` (python) — Package marker for the test suite covering se3's engine step implementations. <!--#429dc51c11cee801|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_commit.py` (python) — Unit tests for the commit step's version-resolution and summary logic, covering auto-repair of RuntimeError/ValueError/KeyError failures from read_version (triggering generate_version_script or initialize_version_system in script/file modes), template-summary generation with optional version-analysis reasoning, and collection of changed files and test results from prior flow steps. <!--#6dd2c4bdf98459bf|0b952c48188f5441-->

  - `TestRuntimeErrorScriptModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_script_mode_retry_fails_propagates` (method) — Asserts that when script-mode repair runs but the retry still raises, the step is FAILED with the error message propagated. <!--#5ff18813092b9539-->
- `TestRuntimeErrorFileModeAutoRepair` (class) — Tests that a RuntimeError from read_version in file mode triggers initialize_version_system() repair and retries. <!--#8031c41efeddcad8-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorFileModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_file_mode_triggers_initialize_version_system` (method) — Asserts a file-mode RuntimeError invokes initialize_version_system() and the retried read_version succeeds with COMPLETED. <!--#f7373cae17a36bfc-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorFileModeAutoRepair.test_runtime_error_file_mode_retry_fails_propagates` (method) — Asserts that when file-mode repair runs but the retry still raises, the step is FAILED with the error message propagated. <!--#6b868950b06bb3c0-->
- `TestRuntimeErrorNoVersionFileAutoRepair` (class) — Tests the no-version-file path where initialize creates a file but read_version then raises RuntimeError, triggering further repair. <!--#ac91eab23364dac4-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorNoVersionFileAutoRepair.test_no_version_file_script_mode_runtime_error_triggers_repair` (method) — Asserts that with no version file in script mode, a post-init RuntimeError triggers generate_version_script() and the retry succeeds. <!--#71491b7883ec47b8-->
  - `TestRuntimeErrorNoVersionFileAutoRepair.test_no_version_file_file_mode_runtime_error_triggers_repair` (method) — Asserts that with no version file in file mode, a post-init RuntimeError triggers a second initialize_version_system() call and the retry succeeds. <!--#78264579a6a6ed1c-->
- `TestValueErrorKeyErrorRegression` (class) — Regression tests confirming pre-existing ValueError/KeyError auto-repair handling still works in both file and script modes. <!--#1febd968836cfde5-->
  - `TestValueErrorKeyErrorRegression.test_value_error_triggers_auto_repair_file_mode` (method) — Asserts a ValueError from read_version in file mode triggers initialize_version_system() repair and completes. <!--#c6fe42c156ac5edb-->
  - `TestValueErrorKeyErrorRegression.test_key_error_triggers_auto_repair_script_mode` (method) — Asserts a KeyError from read_version in script mode triggers generate_version_script() repair and completes. <!--#53b92bcdeb111315-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_implement.py` (python) — Unit tests for the IMPLEMENT step handler covering resume idempotency (skipping completed groups and restoring accumulated state), partial-progress persistence to step.outputs, the _should_use_dag() predicate and its control-flow bypass gates, empty-repo fallback from DAG to sequential execution, and stale branch/worktree cleanup before and after group execution. <!--#5f5480be600bdb81|a6551b4c8b049d08-->

  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.setup_method` (method) — Per-test fixture that builds a temp dir, a feature FlowInstance, and five sample task groups (G1–G5). <!--#901bd36933a7331a-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.teardown_method` (method) — Per-test cleanup that removes the temporary directory. <!--#f17fb20a9042d3fa-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency._create_implement_step` (method) — Helper building an IMPLEMENT Step with configurable resumed flag, implemented_groups, and files-changed count. <!--#b87739434c051e30-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_fresh_start_processes_all_groups` (method) — Asserts a fresh (non-resumed) run processes all five groups in order. <!--#d93a12044e81c9ba-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_skips_already_completed_groups` (method) — Asserts resume filters out groups already listed in implemented_groups, leaving only the remainder. <!--#5e8e8b6a32a7c0a5-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_restores_accumulated_state` (method) — Asserts resume reconstructs all_results and total_files_changed from saved step.outputs. <!--#5503926e736af9c7-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_processes_remaining_groups` (method) — Asserts only the not-yet-completed groups (G3–G5) are processed after resume. <!--#a0eacad0b4cac0a1-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_updates_outputs_after_each_group` (method) — Asserts implemented_groups and total_files_changed are updated incrementally as each group completes. <!--#d77c9564ab05ee27-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_no_resume_flag_processes_all_groups` (method) — Asserts that without the resumed flag all groups are queued for processing. <!--#6fcd5c0dc57ad99f-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_with_empty_implemented_groups_processes_all` (method) — Asserts resume with an empty implemented_groups list still processes all groups. <!--#a5be75176a587a88-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_with_all_groups_completed` (method) — Asserts resume with every group already completed leaves nothing to process. <!--#0093c2281feab014-->
  - `TestImplementResumeIdempotency.test_resume_preserves_other_step_outputs` (method) — Asserts resume processing preserves unrelated step.outputs keys while updating progress. <!--#0bdf73c16c5d150e-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_implement_dag.py` (python) — Integration and unit test suite for the IMPLEMENT step's DAG parallel execution pipeline, covering LOC-threshold routing between single-call and DAG paths, transitive reduction, relay-chain worktree reuse, fork/diamond convergence, mid-chain failure recovery with fallback leaves, LLM-based conflict resolution with take-theirs fallback, output aggregation, and worktree/branch cleanup. <!--#10b493b7efdd44e1|da8d5b7ac4b900ba-->
- `_make_step` (function) — Test helper that builds a Step with IMPLEMENT defaults, overridable via kwargs. <!--#284e23699ff5c822-->
- `_make_flow` (function) — Test helper that builds a FlowInstance with default id/description and optional tmp_path change_path. <!--#7751f1eec2eeef1a-->
- `_make_groups` (function) — Test helper that expands compact (id, order, deps, loc) tuples into full group dicts with tasks. <!--#bccf0c13c2e9e144-->
- `TestLocThresholdRouting` (class) — Test class verifying that total estimated_loc selects the single-LLM-call path vs. the DAG parallel path. <!--#430eb1f8e9e45206-->
  - `TestLocThresholdRouting.test_below_threshold_routes_to_single_call` (method) — Asserts total_loc ≤ 300 routes to a single LLM call and never invokes the DAG path. <!--#1975322af607087e-->
  - `TestLocThresholdRouting.test_above_threshold_routes_to_dag` (method) — Asserts a large fork DAG (total_loc > 300) routes to the DAG parallel path. <!--#24d9fc79465f8563-->
- `TestTransitiveReductionIntegration` (class) — Test class confirming the transitively-reduced DAG flows into classify_chains and DAGScheduler. <!--#12a895ac7bf5c938-->
  - `TestTransitiveReductionIntegration.test_reduced_dag_reaches_scheduler` (method) — Asserts transitive_reduce output is passed to classify_chains and the scheduler receives the reduced groups plus relay_plan. <!--#2b96074cffe972dd-->
- `TestLinearRelayChain` (class) — Test class for a linear G1→G2→G3 chain sharing one worktree with a single final merge. <!--#4783619493a8dab7-->
  - `TestLinearRelayChain.test_single_worktree_reuse_one_merge` (method) — Asserts a linear relay chain produces exactly one leaf merge and one deduplicated worktree cleanup. <!--#b6aeaec8cef187fe-->
  - `TestLinearRelayChain.test_relay_context_passes_worktree` (method) — Asserts DAGScheduler.run is invoked once with a callable execute_fn for building relay contexts. <!--#60feb6148cd55565-->
- `TestForkRelay` (class) — Test class for a G1→{G2,G3} fork where G2 inherits G1's branch and G3 forks, yielding two leaf merges. <!--#2190508233a1e163-->
  - `TestForkRelay.test_fork_produces_two_leaf_merges` (method) — Asserts a fork produces two leaf merges on distinct branches and two worktree cleanups. <!--#dde605de599c96e5-->
  - `TestForkRelay.test_fork_from_in_relay_plan` (method) — Asserts the forked group appears in the relay_plan.fork_from passed to the scheduler. <!--#7b84d3648c5eb680-->
- `TestDiamondConvergence` (class) — Test class for a diamond DAG (G1→{G2,G3}→G4) where G4 is the convergence point and only G4 merges back. <!--#1739b1080e9e3341-->
  - `TestDiamondConvergence.test_diamond_single_leaf_merge` (method) — Asserts a diamond DAG produces a single leaf merge for the convergence node G4 on the relay branch. <!--#6c6acfd0b682f860-->
  - `TestDiamondConvergence.test_convergence_info_in_relay_plan` (method) — Asserts the relay_plan passed to the scheduler carries G4's correct primary and secondary predecessors. <!--#62f6ae27a8e91671-->
- `TestMidChainFailure` (class) — Test class for a chain where a mid-chain group fails, promoting its completed predecessor to a fallback leaf. <!--#2bc22d09edb47992-->
  - `TestMidChainFailure.test_fallback_leaf_merged_on_midchain_failure` (method) — Asserts that on a mid-chain failure the completed predecessor is merged as a fallback leaf and status is PARTIAL. <!--#7253abc91c3e6689-->
  - `TestMidChainFailure.test_skipped_groups_recorded_in_incomplete_tasks` (method) — Asserts failed and skipped groups are both recorded in step.outputs['incomplete_tasks']. <!--#d11e2e7f0608785a-->
  - `TestMidChainFailure.test_all_groups_fail_returns_failed` (method) — Asserts that when all groups fail with no fallback leaves the result is FAILED and no merge occurs. <!--#f8dbba0c5bb26e1e-->

  - `TestConflictResolution.test_conflict_resolved_by_llm` (method) — Asserts a merge conflict resolved by the LLM yields COMPLETED with resolve called using project_root and conflict files. <!--#a7e910b104bd5fb8-->
  - `TestConflictResolution.test_conflict_unresolved_falls_back_to_take_theirs` (method) — Asserts that when the LLM cannot resolve, the take-theirs fallback completes the merge with no merge_failures but an audit event. <!--#1461e014965febcc-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_implement_dag_cleanup.py` (python) — Unit tests for the IMPLEMENT DAG scheduler's branch-cleanup logic, verifying `_is_branch_reachable_from` correctly identifies merged/unmerged/missing branches and that `_run_dag_parallel` deletes safely-merged branches while preserving failed-merge branches and reflecting merge failures in the overall step status. <!--#efe735862e5254c8|b6a3c3efc8f60703-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_implement_merge_robustness.py` (python) — Integration and unit tests exercising the DAG `_merge_leaf_branch` step against real temporary git repos, verifying merge robustness scenarios: pre-merge stashing of dirty/untracked main-repo files, stash-pop conflict take-ours resolution, LLM-exhausted take-theirs fallback, clean abort on commit failure, best-effort YAML audit-issue recording, stash restoration on mid-merge exceptions, and the `_parse_stashpop_already_exists` stderr parser. <!--#d8a3c925efe35b0a|19b76f4c41a945b9-->
- `_git` (function) — Test helper that runs a git subcommand inside a given repo path and returns the CompletedProcess. <!--#cc6b2a27c59d26c1-->

- `_make_leaf_branch` (function) — Test helper that creates a named leaf branch off a base, populates it with given files, commits them, and returns to the base branch. <!--#1374a85c71c6a462-->
- `TestStashPrevention` (class) — Test class verifying that untracked or modified main-repo files no longer block a leaf merge because pre-merge stashing kicks in. <!--#8ed2c305edc6ee03-->
  - `TestStashPrevention.test_untracked_file_in_main_does_not_block_merge` (method) — Test that an untracked main-repo file colliding with a leaf file is stashed away so the merge succeeds and take-ours keeps the leaf version. <!--#46ba0e3ae36c8141-->
  - `TestStashPrevention.test_untracked_unrelated_file_preserved` (method) — Test that a non-colliding untracked main-repo file is stashed, merged around, popped back, and survives in the working tree. <!--#de12af3a5fce765d-->
- `TestStashPopConflict` (class) — Test class verifying that when a post-merge stash pop conflicts, take-ours keeps HEAD's version and an audit event is recorded. <!--#96d18fc3468ce2ac-->
  - `TestStashPopConflict.test_stashpop_conflict_records_audit_issue` (method) — Test that a stash-pop conflict triggers `_record_stashpop_takeours_event` with the correct branch, conflict files, and flow_id. <!--#637a9ee0957c8152-->
- `TestTakeTheirsFallback` (class) — Test class verifying that when the LLM cannot resolve a conflict, the take-theirs fallback preserves the leaf branch's version. <!--#5e669b7abde9eac9-->
  - `TestTakeTheirsFallback.test_llm_exhausted_take_theirs_completes_merge` (method) — Test that on a true 3-way conflict with the LLM mocked to fail, take-theirs accepts the leaf version, commits the merge, and records an audit event. <!--#67dc02139e571c52-->
- `TestTakeTheirsCommitFailure` (class) — Test class verifying that a failed take-theirs commit aborts the merge cleanly with no leftover merge state. <!--#a497481f45177237-->
  - `TestTakeTheirsCommitFailure.test_commit_failure_aborts` (method) — Test that stubbing `_take_theirs_fallback` to fail causes the merge to return False, clears MERGE_HEAD, and leaves main at its pre-merge commit. <!--#970a246d409ed832-->
- `TestAuditIssueIntegration` (class) — Test class verifying that take-theirs/stashpop events write real YAML audit issues and that audit failures don't block the merge. <!--#58c28b4928d03ae2-->
  - `TestAuditIssueIntegration.test_take_theirs_writes_audit_issue_to_se3_issues` (method) — Test that a take-theirs resolution writes a single YAML issue under se3/issues/open/ containing the branch, file, flow_id, and medium priority. <!--#8a64f9f89ca91def-->
  - `TestAuditIssueIntegration.test_audit_failure_does_not_block_merge` (method) — Test that when IssueManager.create raises, the merge still succeeds since audit recording is best-effort. <!--#cf0c7dd5d0b9d0ae-->
- `TestExceptionDuringMerge` (class) — Test class verifying that an exception raised mid-merge still pops the stash before re-raising so untracked files aren't left hidden. <!--#36ebccb2816aa752-->
  - `TestExceptionDuringMerge.test_raise_during_merge_still_pops_stash` (method) — Test that a simulated crash in `_attempt_merge_with_resolution` re-raises but still restores the stashed untracked file and leaves no dangling stash. <!--#7f4c9b6e32f472c6-->
- `TestParseStashpopAlreadyExists` (class) — Test class verifying `_parse_stashpop_already_exists` correctly extracts file paths from git's `<path> already exists, no checkout` stderr output. <!--#a90f3e2b3c2c5688-->
  - `TestParseStashpopAlreadyExists.test_single_file` (method) — Test that the parser extracts a single file path from one 'already exists, no checkout' stderr line. <!--#c56a5a764ab25993-->
  - `TestParseStashpopAlreadyExists.test_multiple_files` (method) — Test that the parser extracts multiple file paths from several 'already exists, no checkout' lines. <!--#c2697e4705b687f4-->
  - `TestParseStashpopAlreadyExists.test_mixed_with_unrelated_output` (method) — Test that the parser matches only lines containing 'no checkout' and ignores unrelated output like 'Already up to date'. <!--#04f1b026b3a0a3e9-->
  - `TestParseStashpopAlreadyExists.test_empty_output` (method) — Test that the parser returns an empty list when git produces no stderr output. <!--#39d26351f8d364ce-->
  - `TestParseStashpopAlreadyExists.test_path_with_subdirs` (method) — Test that the parser correctly extracts a nested subdirectory path from the stderr line. <!--#339cac2af25fe17e-->

### `tests/engine/steps/test_self_check.py` (python) — Unit-test module for the self_check step handler, verifying its COMPLETED/REVISION_NEEDED/FAILED outcomes across no-issue, mixed-severity, max-iteration, LLM-error, and output-storage scenarios, the prompt's content/severity/iteration expectations, and the _format_changes/_format_test_results/_format_spec_content/_format_fix_context helper renderers. <!--#26dab1c091924716|e572294732b73e8f-->
- `_valid_issue` (function) — Module-level test helper that builds a fully-populated, schema-valid self_check issue dict whose defaults align with the standard flow/step fixtures so it survives validation. <!--#2f256e581ac12950-->
- `TestSelfCheckHandler` (class) — Test class exercising self_check_handler end-to-end across no-issues, mixed-severity, max-iteration, LLM-error, output-storage, prompt-content, and iteration-sentinel scenarios. <!--#2cdb455e67e98e63-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.flow` (method) — Pytest fixture returning a RUNNING feature FlowInstance with a standard selected-steps sequence for handler tests. <!--#35eb92e146f61c10-->

  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_completed_when_no_issues` (method) — Asserts the handler returns COMPLETED with zero actionable issues when the LLM reports an empty issues list. <!--#2491b6dbff72040f-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_revision_needed_when_medium_low_issues` (method) — Asserts medium/low-severity issues still trigger REVISION_NEEDED with the correct actionable count and fix_needed flag. <!--#d1dc7590f4edcc0d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_revision_needed_with_critical_issues` (method) — Asserts a critical issue yields REVISION_NEEDED and populates fix_context with reason, issues, and incremented iteration. <!--#a904b1e903284164-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_revision_needed_with_high_issues` (method) — Asserts high-severity issues yield REVISION_NEEDED and that fix_instructions text includes the issue's actual-behavior description. <!--#7e8b817f18fbf94a-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_revision_needed_at_max_iterations` (method) — Asserts self_check still returns REVISION_NEEDED at the iteration cap, leaving exhaustion handling to the state machine. <!--#3452030569d99566-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_failed_on_llm_error` (method) — Asserts the handler returns FAILED and records the error message when the LLM call raises. <!--#f417627473d74814-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_returns_failed_on_unparseable_response` (method) — Asserts the handler returns FAILED with an error message when the LLM response cannot be parsed as JSON. <!--#fddc0497794ae132-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_fix_context_contains_all_issues` (method) — Asserts fix_context carries all four mixed-severity issues when each issue's evidence path is present in changes_made. <!--#db6c72daa2285d8d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_uses_two_phase_json_mode` (method) — Asserts the handler invokes the LLM caller with two_phase json_mode and a json_schema_hint. <!--#3dcc8f4c5d567591-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_prompt_excludes_spec_compliance` (method) — Asserts the SELF_CHECK_PROMPT instructs the checker not to report spec-compliance issues. <!--#13d01de3235d0e3d-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_prompt_excludes_version_decisions` (method) — Asserts the prompt defers version-bump/pyproject decisions to the downstream version_analyze step rather than flagging them. <!--#944c201f9580e3b0-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_prompt_includes_review_dimensions` (method) — Asserts the prompt names the expected review dimensions (logic completeness, robustness, functional gaps, test-coverage gaps). <!--#6484f7ab8b48109b-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_prompt_uses_severity_not_priority` (method) — Asserts the prompt uses a severity field with critical|high|medium|low values rather than priority. <!--#43ecb74218addecb-->
  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_fix_iteration_passed_to_prompt` (method) — Asserts the current fix_iteration value is rendered into the LLM prompt text. <!--#19e84df3c87a4882-->

  - `TestSelfCheckHandler.test_stores_self_check_result` (method) — Asserts the raw LLM result (summary and issues) is stored under outputs['self_check_result']. <!--#06959bb3a49127b6-->

## `tests/frontend/` — The frontend test suite for the WebUI server's static app.js, combining DOM-free Node assertion modules — registered into the shared test_app_pure.mjs harness — that exercise the running-flow console's pure helpers (record normalization, collapse/disclosure, agent/model badges, group-status cards, scroll-anchor preservation, end/resume eligibility, issue-management, mobile-responsive state) and regression guards that replay captured daemon-frame fixtures to prove the live incremental-append render converges with full-reload snapshots, alongside a manual smoke-test checklist. <!--#fee11f8320a0b884|36f7e248b6924225-->

### `tests/frontend/SMOKE_CHECKLIST.md` (markdown) — A manual smoke-test checklist for the running-flow full-screen chat view, walking through environment setup, layout, reply box, conversation/intervention rendering, three-tier disclosure, CLI↔Web parity, targeted bugfix acceptance checks, and a final regression pass, with a recorded table of the last automated run's results. <!--#8b01cd448a920d43|d282cc8d28b6c66e-->
- `Running-Flow Chat View — Manual Smoke Checklist` (heading) — Top-level title and scope statement describing the full-screen chat view under test and which backend/static files trigger a re-run of this checklist. <!--#792347f5ecc19cd2-->
  - `Setup` (heading) — Step-by-step environment setup for the smoke pass: install server, start central server and daemon, launch a flow, and open the web console. <!--#54b20d62b22c8130-->
  - `Pure-function regression` (heading) — A single check that the pure-function interaction-view test suite reports zero failures before manual testing. <!--#27e8aaa7b1ed2f88-->
  - `Layout` (heading) — Checks that the running flow renders as a full-screen view with the conversation as the main scrollable column and no legacy drawer or context-free call modal. <!--#a7f59a53399f7006-->
  - `Reply input box` (heading) — Checks the always-present bottom reply box behavior: enabled textarea, Send as the gate, pending/no-pending placeholders, and the inline Interject (✎) button. <!--#43636e585cf618e6-->
  - `Conversation rendering` (heading) — Checks that assistant/intervention records render expanded while user/system template records collapse into one-line chips classified by structured role. <!--#5b9dc5aa14172c0b-->
  - `Three-tier progressive disclosure (message paradigm)` (heading) — Checks the B1 message paradigm's layered disclosure for user/assistant turns, paradigm-named step headers, and long-payload wrapping. <!--#658af6c353d97756-->
  - `Intervention items (one per kind, default-expanded & prominent)` (heading) — Checks that each intervention kind (call, interjection, retry_decision, cli_confirm) appears as a distinct, default-expanded, visually separate item. <!--#a11676c589c0c151-->
  - `Standards 1–5 CLI ↔ Web parity (G6 acceptance)` (heading) — Step-by-step parity checks pinning that the web flow view matches CLI Rich output across five standards, each backed by named automated tests. <!--#23530143e28feba2-->
  - `Bugfix smoke (actual-render acceptance)` (heading) — Actual-render acceptance checks for two bugfixes: shorter mobile folded tool-call cards and desktop replies showing exactly once without duplication. <!--#5b4ca3ce0e03018c-->
  - `Bugfix smoke (collectJsonRegions structural robustness)` (heading) — Checks that structured-step assistant turns with literal triple backticks inside JSON content still render as prose plus a structured card, not a raw json blob. <!--#fcec8c0ef74bcad3-->
  - `Regression` (heading) — Checks that the full pytest suite and both frontend JS test files pass before sign-off. <!--#cdfc2d0ee842253d-->
    - `Recorded automated results (2026-05-21)` (heading) — A recorded table of the last automated test run's pass/skip counts plus a note on pre-existing out-of-scope test_steps.py failures. <!--#6b3c940aa0ca3b76-->

### `tests/frontend/agent_badge_live.test.mjs` (text) — A node-stub frontend test suite (Group G3) that verifies the live accumulating-bubble agent/model badge behavior in the running-flow console — covering first-fragment badge display, in-place upgrade to "agent · model", agent-rotation model clearing, and backward-compatible absence of a badge when no agent metadata is present. <!--#1e4c2bd75fbb98dd|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/end_session.test.mjs` (text) — A DOM-free Node.js test suite that exercises the End-session pure helpers in the server's static app.js (isFlowEndable, isWorktreeSessionPath, isEndInProgress), asserting which flow statuses, worktree paths, and source/origin combinations make a flow eligible for ending. <!--#bec8f4a7142d43fc|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/flow_resume.test.mjs` (text) — DOM-free Node assertion tests for app.js's pure Resume-flow helpers (isFlowResumable, RESUMABLE_STATUSES, isResumeInProgress), covering status/source/case-insensitivity rules and the authoritative `resumable` flag's precedence over the legacy heuristic. <!--#5538adf9a03a59e1|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/group_status.test.mjs` (text) — A frontend test module exporting `registerGroupStatusTests` that drives the parent harness's check() reporter to verify per-group DAG `group_status` records normalize correctly, map every status to its localized label (with fallbacks), and render as in-place `.group-status-marker` cards that fold successive same-group states into one terminal card without disturbing interleaved chat bubbles. <!--#6dc3561406e0ad52|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/interaction_view.test.mjs` (text) — A dependency-free Node assertion script that imports the web console's real pure helpers from app.js (normalizeRecord, isCollapsibleRole, normalizeKind, chipLabel, echo-dedup) and verifies the chat view's collapse/expand decisions are driven structurally by each record's role rather than by guessing from message text. <!--#56a79a1cbf88a1a4|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/issue209_real_frame_replay.test.mjs` (text) — Frontend regression guard for issue #209 that replays the exact real daemon frame sequence (discovery→analyze→plan-failure) captured in fixtures/issue_209/daemon_frames.json, asserting the live incremental-append path (applyHistoryData/dedupeAppendRecords) converges on the full-reload snapshot with no record loss, duplication, or freeze, and that re-delivered resume-burst batches dedupe to a single render. <!--#1938c8ba792d1940|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/issue217_scroll_anchor.test.mjs` (text) — A node-stub frontend test suite (registered into test_app_pure.mjs) that pins the element-anchored scroll-preservation fix for issue #217/#209, verifying that captureScrollAnchor/restoreScrollAnchor keep the reader's bubble at the same viewport offset across a from-scratch renderConversation rebuild when content above grows, follow the record by recordKey rather than index, and fall back to absolute scrollTop when geometry or the anchor is missing. <!--#3ca6e8873b328ce8|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/issue_management.test.mjs` (text) — Group G7 frontend unit tests exposing `registerIssueManagementTests` for the shared pure-helper harness, covering DOM-free issue-management logic: title derivation, slug generation, issue filtering/type collection, panel state, status/priority CSS class mapping, type constants, machine_id key contract, and create/edit/action request-body builders. <!--#281a759aad131c26|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->

### `tests/frontend/live_append_after_respond.test.mjs` (text) — A frontend regression test module (issue #193) that registers live-append-after-respond tests verifying the running-flow view keeps appending daemon-pushed `mode:append` records after a respond/interject — deduping overlapping batches, reconciling optimistic reply echoes against authoritative user records, and preserving first-worktree assistant bodies. <!--#da673c5c0b65c9ee|e3b0c44298fc1c14-->
